stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Modi completes 4,399 days as PM, surpasses Nehru's record The PM has reached the Bharat Mandapam and is expected to address a high-level NDA meeting at New Delhi. Notably, several Chief Ministers have already arrived at the venue. 2. Ram Mandir theft case reaches PM Modi, BJP leader writes letter to PMO Ayodhya BJP leader Dr. Rajnish Singh complained to Prime Minister Modi on Tuesday about the alleged theft of offerings at the Ram Temple. He has written a letter to the PMO demanding an impartial investigation. Meanwhile, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav has again raised the issue of alleged theft at the Ram Temple. He called it 'Chadhava Chori Kand' (Offering Theft Scandal) on X and demanded an impartial investigation and bringing out the truth. 3. Rahul to face another hearing over 'Ram is fictional' statement A petition demanding an FIR against Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for allegedly calling Lord Ram fictional will be heard again in the Varanasi Court. The senior court of MP-MLA on Wednesday cancelled the lower court's order, which stated that the petition was not maintainable. 4. Mamata-Sonia meet followed by Rahul-Abhishek talks A day after Trinamool Congress chairperson Mamata Banerjee met Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi at her 10 Janpath residence, TMC national general secretary and MP Abhishek Banerjee held talks with Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi. 5. Karni Sena chief announces UP election plan Karni Sena President Surajpal Singh's ('Ammu') aggressive stance has started a new stir in UP politics. Ammu announced that Karni Sena is not a slave of the BJP. It will field candidates for 50 seats in the upcoming assembly elections. He also attacked BJP ally SBSP chief Om Prakash Rajbhar by calling him 'incompetent' and his party Apna Dal a 'dream party'. 6. 49 gangs on police radar in Ghazipur, Whatsapp group of 300 goons created After the murder of a hotel businessman's son, the Khoda and Katra areas of Ghazipur have turned into a police camp. The leader of the 'Katra Gang' that carried out the incident, Shankar Pandey, used to portray himself as the notorious criminal 'Shri Prakash Shukla'. 7. Pakistan carries out new strikes on Afghanistan The Taliban government in Kabul on Wednesday accused Pakistan of carrying out overnight air strikes inside Afghanistan that killed at least 13 people and injured 14 others. 8. Triple death tragedy in Baghpat, father and son shot dead over old rivalry A tent business owner and his 30-year-old son were shot dead after armed assailants stormed their shop in Uttar Pradesh’s Baghpat district. The incident took place around 5:50 pm on Tuesday in Baraut market, when three criminals arrived on two motorcycles and opened fire on the father-son duo. 9. ‘Dreamed of becoming police officer, ended up being a criminal’, Gorakhpur examinee caught with hidden mobile ‘Sir, please forgive me... I wanted to become a policeman, but in the pursuit of shortcuts, I became a criminal. Please let me go this time, I will never do anything wrong again.’ These were the words spoken by 23-year-old Ram Prakash Chauhan while pleading before the police in Gorakhpur. He was caught taking photos of the question paper with his mobile phone during the UP Police recruitment examination. 10. Trump warns Iran will ‘pay price’ for delaying peace deal US President Donald Trump has said Iran “took too long” to negotiate a deal with Washington and will now “pay the price” for the delay, without elaborating on what consequences he meant.

stories.title: Maulana accused of rape in mosque arrested in encounter:Firozabad police shoot him in leg; had been teaching at mosque for 25 years
stories.summary: In Firozabad, police have arrested a Maulana in an encounter who raped a 14-year-old girl in a mosque. Police shot the accused Maulana in the leg. SP City Ravi Shankar Prasad said, “2 teams were formed to arrest the accused. Information was received on Wednesday that the accused was planning to escape.” “Ramgarh police station conducted a siege. Police force was deployed at every corner and checking was started. Blockades were set up at intersections. Meanwhile, the Maulana was spotted waiting for someone near Naipai underpass. As soon as he saw the police, the Maulana started running. When chased, he started firing with a pistol,” SP said. “In retaliatory firing, the Maulana was shot in the leg. He was injured. After this, the team caught him. A case has also been registered against the accused under the Arms Act. The accused Maulana had raped a minor girl on June 7 in the mosque who had come to fill cold water from the water cooler. He had threatened to kill her,” he added. See pictures- Now understand entire case in a sequential manner According to police, on June 7, 2026, around 1 PM, the victim had gone to fill water from the water cooler installed in the mosque. It is alleged that Zakir Hafiz (48), who was present in the mosque at that time, found the minor girl alone and forcibly grabbed her. He covered her mouth and took her to his room. He raped her. When she resisted, he beat her up. He threatened to kill her if she told anyone and fled. After the incident, based on the victim's mother's complaint, a case was registered at Ramgarh police station under sections of rape and POCSO Act. Two teams were formed for the arrest SSP Aditya Langhe formed two police teams for the arrest of the accused. The police were continuously conducting raids at possible locations. Meanwhile, the police received information about the accused's location from an informer. The police recovered one illegal .315 bore pistol, two empty cartridges and two live cartridges from the possession of the accused. After primary treatment, the injured accused was sent to the district hospital in police custody. Imam has been teaching in a mosque for 25 years According to local people, the accused Zakir had been teaching Urdu to children in the mosque for the past approximately 25 years. He is a resident of Lane Number 42, Mampi Kinnar Wali Gali. He has 5 children. All five are married. His eldest daughter also has children.

stories.title: UP panchayat voter list revised:29 lakh voters added, 2 crore names deleted; every voter gets 9-digit ID
stories.summary: The final voter list for panchayat elections in UP was released on Wednesday. This final list has been prepared after resolution of all claims, objections and thorough verification. The State Election Commission has made a major change this time by issuing a unique 9-digit identification number to every panchayat voter. However, as soon as the list was released, voters in many districts are facing huge difficulties in downloading it. However, this is happening due to technical glitches. Voter base increases by 29 lakh According to the final electoral roll, a total of 12.58 crore voters will now be eligible to cast their votes in the Panchayat elections across Uttar Pradesh. Before the revision process, the voter count stood at 12.29 crore. The latest revision has increased the number of voters by 29.01 lakh. The commission added 2.32 crore new voters to the electoral roll during the revision exercise. At the same time, 2.03 crore names were removed due to reasons such as duplicate registrations, change of address, death of voters and other eligibility-related issues. Over 11 lakh names removed after objection process During the first phase of voter list revision, the total number of voters had reached 12.69 crore. However, after claims and objections were examined and resolved, 11.18 lakh names were removed from the list. Officials said the final list reflects the outcome of a detailed verification process aimed at ensuring accurate voter records. Panchayat elections yet to be announced Although the final voter list has been released, the schedule for Panchayat elections has not yet been announced. The tenure of village heads (Gram Pradhans) ended on May 26. Since elections could not be conducted on time, the state government decided to allow outgoing village heads to continue functioning as administrators for the next six months. OBC reservation review underway The Uttar Pradesh government has also constituted a Backward Classes Commission to examine reservation for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) in Panchayat elections. The commission has been asked to conduct a district-wise assessment of the social and economic status of backward communities and submit its report within six months. The findings are expected to play a key role in determining the reservation framework for the upcoming elections. Elections not yet decided, Pradhans will hold the chair for the next 6 months The tenure of Gram Pradhans in UP ended on May 26. Due to elections not being held on time, the government took a major decision. The outgoing Pradhans have been assigned responsibility as administrators for the next 6 months. The government has also formed a Backward Classes Commission regarding reservation for Other Backward Classes in panchayat elections. This commission has been asked to submit its report after reviewing the district-wise economic and social status within 6 months. Stuck in High Court - Report sought in July Although the UP government has given the commission 6 months' time, a petition filed for conducting panchayat elections soon is still pending in the Allahabad High Court. Taking a strict stance on this, the High Court has directed the OBC Commission to submit its report in July itself. Assembly elections are to be held in UP in February-March. Political parties fear that conducting panchayat elections just before the assembly elections could cause heavy damage to their organization and electoral preparations. Actually, panchayat elections are not fought on party lines. Due to this, the battle for dominance and factionalism at the local level is at its peak. Many times two strong workers of the same party come face to face in the election field. In such situations, people forget party discipline. This poses a risk of the party cadre getting scattered during the main elections. In the state, elections for Gram Panchayat along with Kshetra Panchayat (BDC) and Zila Panchayat members are to be conducted together.

stories.title: 'Ram is fictional' remark lands Rahul Gandhi in legal trouble:Varanasi court orders fresh hearing of FIR petition against LoP
stories.summary: A petition demanding an FIR against Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for allegedly calling Lord Ram fictional will be heard again in the Varanasi Court. The senior court of MP-MLA on Wednesday cancelled the lower court's order, which stated that the petition was not maintainable. Additional District Judge (ADJ) Yajuvendra Vikram Singh has sent the case back to the lower court and ordered a fresh hearing. Rahul Gandhi is accused of calling Lord Ram fictional at Brown University in New York, America. Advocate Harishankar Pandey had filed the petition on May 12 last year. It was claimed that Rahul Gandhi had described Lord Ram as 'mythological' at Brown University in America. On June 10, 2026, the Chief Judicial Magistrate (MP-MLA) court dismissed the petition. Against this order, Harishankar Pandey had filed a revision petition in the District Judge's court on September 26, 2025. Petitioner says if found guilty, 5 years imprisonment Senior Advocate Harishankar Pandey said that there is a complete basis for the hearing against Rahul Gandhi. Our petition has been accepted on this very basis. The court has accepted that Rahul Gandhi had called Lord Ram imaginary. He said that a demand has been made to register an FIR against Rahul Gandhi under sections 163 and 4 of BNS. These sections are considered serious offenses. If Rahul is found guilty, he could face 5 years' imprisonment. The hearing on the petition will take place in court in the first week of next month. 'Rahul is insulting Hindus by making irresponsible statements' Advocate Harishankar Pandey claimed in the petition that Rahul Gandhi had gone to Boston, America, on April 21, 2025. He had a session with students at Brown University. Here, Rahul had made controversial statements about Lord Shri Ram. He had called Lord Ram 'mythological'. He also called the stories told about that era fictional. Rahul Gandhi and the Congress Party are continuously insulting Hindus by making irresponsible statements about the previous incarnations and great symbols of Sanatan Dharma. Rahul says BJP's approach is hate-mongering Rahul Gandhi was asked what secular politics should be like in the era of Hindu nationalism. Can Mahatma Gandhi's ideas be used against it? In response, Rahul Gandhi had said that all the great reformers and thinkers of India, like Buddha, Guru Nanak, Gandhi, and Ambedkar, lived without discrimination. These people were forgiving, compassionate, and tolerant. But, the BJP's approach does not represent Hinduism; it is hate-mongering.

stories.title: Lucknow metro's east-west corridor gains momentum:₹127 cr high-tech depot to be built in Vasant Kunj; GHV India awarded contract
stories.summary: The construction work of the proposed East-West Corridor of Lucknow Metro has crossed another important milestone. The Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation (UPMRC) has awarded the contract for the construction of the metro depot to be built in Vasantkunj to GHV (India) Private Limited. This depot, to be built at a cost of approximately ₹127 crore, will be the main center for maintenance and operation of the metro trains of the East-West Corridor. According to UPMRC, 5 companies participated in the open tender process issued for depot construction. After technical and financial evaluation, the bid of GHV (India) Private Limited was found to be most suitable. The estimated cost of the project was approximately ₹150 crore. Construction will be on the lines of Transport Nagar depot The new depot being built in Vasant Kunj will be developed on the lines of Lucknow Metro's existing depot located at Transport Nagar. Modern facilities for stabling, regular inspection, repair, and technical maintenance of metro trains will be available here. This depot will play a crucial role in the safe and smooth operation of the East-West Corridor. UPMRC's Managing Director, Sushil Kumar, said that the depot will be developed as a modern and technology-driven facility, where world-class maintenance infrastructure will be available. Depot will be equipped with high-tech machines State-of-the-art machines will be installed in the depot for train maintenance. Among these, the pit wheel lathe machine will be prominent, through which wear and tear of metro coach wheels will be corrected. This machine will rectify changes in wheel profiles that occur during continuous operation, ensuring safe movement of trains. Additionally, facilities such as fully automated synchronized pit jacks and mobile jack machines, bogie turntable, automatic train washing plant, electric bogie shunter, and re-railing and rescue vehicles will also be installed. With their help, train maintenance and quick action in emergency situations will be possible. Will be developed as a Green Depot UPMRC is placing special emphasis on making this depot environment-friendly. A zero-discharge system will be implemented in the depot, ensuring that no wastewater from the premises goes outside. For this, a dual plumbing system, Sewage Treatment Plant (STP), and Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) will be installed. The treated water will be reused for train washing, cleaning, and other works. To promote water conservation, the STP and ETP will be developed as an integrated system. Large arrangements will also be made for water storage Raw water tanks, domestic water tanks for household use, and fire water tanks for emergency situations will be constructed at the depot. This arrangement will be similar to Transport Nagar Depot, where an effective system of water storage and reuse is already operational. Project gains new momentum With the awarding of the depot construction contract, the initial activities of the East-West Corridor project will gain momentum. UPMRC believes that this step will prove significant in bringing the project to ground level and will further strengthen Lucknow's urban transport network.

stories.title: VIDEO| Triple death tragedy in Baghpat:Father and son shot dead over old rivalry; attacker also killed
stories.summary: A tent business owner and his 30-year-old son were shot dead after armed assailants stormed their shop in Uttar Pradesh’s Baghpat district. The incident took place around 5:50 pm on Tuesday in Baraut market, when three criminals arrived on two motorcycles and opened fire on the father-son duo. According to police, the son, Vikas, confronted the attackers and managed to grab hold of history-sheeter Varun Luhari. During the ensuing struggle, Varun’s accomplices opened fire on Vikas. However, the shot missed its target and instead struck Varun. The daylight shooting in the middle of a busy market triggered panic among shoppers and passersby. As the attackers attempted to flee while firing indiscriminately, locals managed to catch hold of the injured Varun. During the chaos, someone from the crowd allegedly shot him. A video of the incident surfaced on Wednesday, showing Varun lying on the ground while the sound of two to three gunshots can be heard in the background. A passerby was also injured in the firing. Police rushed to the spot and shifted all the injured to a hospital, where doctors declared the father and son dead. Varun Luhari was later referred to a hospital in Meerut for treatment, but succumbed to his injuries. Police are investigating the incident and searching for the remaining accused. Video of the incident Now, understand the entire incident in a sequential manner Son got married 6 months ago, wife is pregnant Businessman Sohanlal's (50) son Vikas got married six months ago. His wife is two months pregnant. Now, only the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are left in the family. The last rites of father and son were performed on Wednesday morning. In protest of the incident, traders have kept the market closed. A procession was taken out on the road. General Secretary of the Industry and Trade Association, Vicky Chaudhary, said that the accused should be encountered. See pictures of the incident... Vikas got married in December 2025 Sohanlal Agarwal (50), a resident of Baraut, runs a tent business. He has a shop near the Baraut bus stand. At home live the businessman's wife, Usha (48), only son Vikas (30) and his wife, Neha (28). Vikas got married in December 2025. On Tuesday evening, Vikas had gone to his father Sohanlal's shop for some work. Both were sitting inside the shop. Crowd chased and caught one criminal At 5:50 PM, three criminals came on two bikes. One criminal took out a pistol and looked inside the shop. As soon as he saw Sohanlal and Vikas inside the shop, he started firing rapidly. The businessman and his son died due to bullet injuries. During the firing, one bullet also hit a passerby, Rohit (35). He fell on the road injured. The passerby is undergoing treatment in the hospital. Protested by blocking the National Highway Angered by the broad daylight murder, the businessman's relatives and traders blocked the Delhi-Saharanpur National Highway. The businessman's wife and daughter-in-law, Neha, also reached the spot. Both sat on the road and started demanding justice from the police. On receiving information about the jam, DM Asmit Lal and SP Suraj Rai reached the spot. The DM consoled the businessman's wife by hugging her and assured action. The SP pacified the family members and traders and got the road blockade cleared. SP Suraj Rai informed - 10 teams have been formed to solve the case. Police arrested Varun Luhari's father, Baburam, late at night. Strict action will be taken against the accused. Cousin's claim - 10 criminals from Luhari gang came Vikas's cousin Varun Agarwal said that the Varun Luhari gang attacked their family. The family was attacked about 9 years ago as well. However, at that time, no security was provided by the police. This time too, there were not adequate security arrangements, due to which the criminals carried out the incident. About 10 criminals were involved in the incident. Local shopkeepers said that there was enmity between Sohanlal and criminal Varun Luhari since 2016. Next to the place where Sohanlal's tent shop is, there was a liquor shop at that time. Varun Luhari had come to the shop to buy liquor. At that time, there was a fight between the two over some matter. A young man died in the fight. Since then, there has been animosity between the two parties. Animosity that started over ₹100 in 2016 Know about criminal Varun Luhari- Criminal Varun Luhari had a total of 16 cases registered against him, including serious crimes like murder, extortion and threats. He had stepped into the world of crime in 2010. It started with minor assault cases, but gradually, he became one of the notorious criminals of Western Uttar Pradesh. According to police officials, recently, during an encounter, he had also fired at a police team and an inspector. Varun Luhari's name also came up in the famous shooting incident at Delhi Bus Stand on July 17, 2015. In that incident, rapid firing was done at a tent business family. His brother Kapil died due to bullet injuries. This case is still pending in court.

stories.title: Varanasi records 42°C, ranks 8th among state’s hottest cities:With 37% humidity in air; temple authorities lay mats for devotees
stories.summary: The sun has been out since this morning in Varanasi. The temperature has been recorded at 42°C. Varanasi is the 8th hottest city in the state. The wind speed is 11 kilometers per hour, while the humidity remains at 37%, which is causing oppressive heat. The Meteorological Department has predicted rain between June 12 and 14. According to expert Prof. Manoj Srivastava, this will be pre-monsoon rain. After the 14th, the heat may show its intense form for two to three days. See picture Water being poured on mats at Kashi Vishwanath, arrangements made for coolers and drinking water Regarding protection from sun, heat, hot winds, and scorching temperatures at Kashi Vishwanath Dham, i.e., Vishwanath Corridor, the Chief Executive Officer of the temple, Vishwa Bhushan Mishra, informed that for devotees visiting Kashi Vishwanath Dham, arrangements have been made for water coolers, wet jute mats on the ground, and German hangers for shade. Efforts are being made to provide better facilities to devotees for protection from heat through modern technology as well. He also mentioned that apart from all these temporary solutions, better permanent options will also be worked out and implemented for the devotees. A temporary hospital has been established at the Dham. Medical services are available there. Monsoon expected to reach Kashi by June 25 After the monsoon's entry into Kerala, the weather mood in Kashi has also started to change. According to meteorologists, there is a possibility of the monsoon reaching the district by June 25. However, the Indian Meteorological Department has not yet announced the official date of monsoon entry into Uttar Pradesh, but looking at the wind direction and humidity conditions, the probable date may be released in the next three to four days.

stories.title: Flats possession to be given by Diwali in Khorabar scheme:EWS, LIG, and mini MIG tower work in final stage
stories.summary: The construction of EWS, LIG, and Mini MIG flats in the Khorabar Township and Medicity scheme being developed by Gorakhpur Development Authority (GDA) is in its final phase. GDA Vice Chairman Abhinav Gopal, who arrived on Tuesday evening to inspect the progress of the scheme, directed that the work be completed on time. He said that possession should be given to allottees of some flats by Diwali. The remaining work should also be expedited. During the inspection, he observed the progress of construction work. He visited various blocks of the project for about 1 hour and saw the construction work being carried out there. He also observed the work being done on the infrastructure. He also inspected the electricity arrangements. There was a plan to install 6 transformers of 600 KVA at the site. The Vice Chairman asked to install 3 large transformers. Electrical engineers were told to install 3 transformers of 1500 KVA. The space that will be saved from this can be used for something else. Khorabar Township has 2000 flats In the Khorabar Township scheme, approximately 2000 flats and 312 residential plots are being developed. These will provide housing for various income groups. In the Medicity scheme connected to the project, 46 large plots have also been developed under the Clinic Lane, where hospitals, nursing homes, diagnostic centers, and other health service-related institutions can be established. Residential construction will also be permitted on these plots. A total of 420 houses are being built in two blocks in the Mini MIG category. A total of 480 flats are proposed in the LIG category. The construction of the first block has been completed, while in the second block, structural work up to the 13th floor has been completed. Finishing work is progressing rapidly in both blocks. Similarly, out of seven blocks in the EWS category, five blocks will be completely ready in the next two months. Out of a total of 560 dwellings, preparations are underway to hand over possession of approximately 400 dwellings. However, construction work is still ongoing in 10 blocks of the MIG category. It will take some more time for the 560 flats in this category to be ready. According to officials, their construction is likely to be completed by August-September. Construction work up to the 13th floor has been completed in three towers, while construction of upper floors is ongoing in other towers. The authority says that the target has been set to fully develop the entire township by December 2026. Returning from Khorabar, the GDA Vice Chairman also inspected the under-construction Greenwood Apartment in the Taramandal area, checked its progress, and asked for the work to be completed on time. During the inspection, Chief Engineer-in-Charge Kishan Singh, Assistant Engineer AK Tayal, Rajbahadur Singh, Junior Engineer Agyaram Verma, Manish Tripathi, along with other officials, were present. List of defaulters to be prepared GDA Vice Chairman held a review meeting of the Property Department on Tuesday afternoon. He took detailed information about the OTS scheme, property allotments, status of defaulter allottees, and vacant properties. The Vice Chairman said that outstanding dues should be recovered. Unpopular properties were also discussed. He said that the benefit of the OTS scheme should be given to the maximum number of people. The Property Department will be reviewed once every 15 days. He said that all properties should be verified afresh. A proposal for the beautification of kiosks located in Padelganj was also brought up in the meeting.

stories.title: Metal detectors used to check mouth,trousers during constable exam:Girls asked to open hair and remove jewellery; 5 candidates caught cheating
stories.summary: The UP constable recruitment exam for 32,679 posts is being held today, Wednesday, which is the third and final day. Candidates arrived at 1,183 centers at 8 AM for the first shift of the examination. Candidates were given entry only after admit card verification, biometric matching, and retina scan. In Jaunpur, checking was done by inserting metal detectors in candidates' mouths and pants. In Maharajganj, female candidates' sacred threads (kalawa) were removed from their hands. In Hathras, male candidates were made to remove their shoes and socks. Female candidates were made to remove their jewelry. Hair buns were opened, and searches were conducted. Strict security arrangements have been made at examination centers across the state. Cases have been registered against several social media accounts spreading rumors. In Hardoi, one candidate was caught with a mobile phone and an old question paper. In Kanpur, one candidate was caught carrying an electronic gadget before the exam started. The first shift exam will be held from 10 AM to 12 PM, while the second shift exam will be held from 3 PM to 5 PM. 28,86,797 candidates have applied to become constables. In the first two days of the exam, around 20 lakh candidates were called, but 4.69 lakh skipped the exam. 5 cheaters were also caught in Aligarh, Muzaffarnagar, Kanpur, and Hardoi. stories.title: ‘Dreamed of becoming police officer, ended up being a criminal’:Gorakhpur examinee caught with hidden mobile
stories.summary: 'Sir, please forgive me... I wanted to become a policeman, but in the pursuit of shortcuts, I became a criminal. Please let me go this time, I will never do anything wrong again.' These were the words spoken by 23-year-old Ram Prakash Chauhan while pleading before the police in Gorakhpur. He was caught taking photos of the question paper with his mobile phone during the UP Police recruitment examination. The accused is a resident of Bihar. On Monday, he had come to Nina Thapa Inter College in Gorakhpur to take the second shift examination to become a constable. He managed to dodge the five-layer checking at the college gate and reached the exam room. Upon being caught, he broke down crying in front of the police. He was repeatedly asking for forgiveness. The police informed the accused's family members and sent him to jail. The police have left for Bihar to apprehend his cousin brother. Had to send photo of paper to cousin brother's mobile Ram Prakash Chauhan is a resident of Belwariya village in Asthawa police station area of Nalanda district in Bihar. He has studied up to the 12th standard. He appeared for several competitive examinations, but did not succeed. Ram Prakash told during interrogation that the police post holds lots of power. That's why I also started preparing to become a policeman. I used to wake up every morning and practice running. I also studied at home. But I was a bit weak in my studies. My elder cousin brother also appears for competitive examinations. He is very sharp in his studies. I had made a plan to cheat in the police examination by sitting with him. Bought underwear a day before Ram Prakash said that his cousin brother had told him - Competitive exams don't happen every day. If you want to pass the exam this time by any means, you will have to take a risk. If somehow you can enter the exam room with a mobile, the job will be done. Take a photo of the paper and send it. I will immediately look it up on Google here and send you the answer. This thing stuck in my mind. After this, I bought a new pair of underwear on June 7, a day before the exam, so that the mobile could be hidden inside it. Got scared seeing the checking at the center Ram Prakash said that the second shift exam was to start at 3 p.m. I had reached the examination center two hours early. I got scared seeing the checking at the gate there. I stood outside and watched for quite some time. Then I went to the side and hid the Android mobile properly inside my underwear. When I felt reassured, I went towards the gate. I was checked thoroughly there. But there was no problem. After this, I felt that now my dream of becoming a police officer would be fulfilled. In the exam room, I kept looking at the paper for 25 minutes. Then, when all the candidates got busy writing, I slowly took out the mobile from my underwear. I took photos of the paper. But I was caught just before sending them to my cousin brother on WhatsApp. Parents will be greatly disgraced - he pleaded Ramprakash started crying in front of the police. He said that if parents come to know at home, there will be great disgrace. People in society will also speak ill. Please forgive me once, I will never do wrong work again. Father is a farmer. I want to do something for him. FIR filed based on room inspector's report An FIR has been registered under sections of the Examination Act, including fraud against candidate Ramprakash Chauhan, who was caught based on a complaint by Pravesh Pratap Singh, room inspector of Nina Thapa Inter College. The candidate's cousin brother has also been made an accused in this case. A police team has also left for Bihar in search of the accused cousin brother. Action taken against 2 inspectors and 6 constables when questions arose during investigation Even after five-layer checking, Ram Prakash managed to get inside by hiding the mobile in his underwear. This raised questions about the checking process. Police officials conducted an investigation and suspended 2 sub-inspectors, Ankit Kumar, Chandreshwar Yadav, and 6 constables who were on duty. A departmental inquiry has also been initiated against them. In this regard, SP City Nimish Patil said that legal action has been taken against the accused candidate. Action has also been taken against 2 sub-inspectors and 4 constables who were negligent during checking in the examination. SP North is investigating the matter. Further action will be taken after the departmental inquiry. Know about constable recruitment.… Notification was issued on 31 December 2025 for 32,679 constable and equivalent posts. Online applications were received till 30 January 2026. 29 lakh 45 thousand candidates had applied. During verification, 60 thousand applications were cancelled. Admit cards have been issued for 28 lakh 85 thousand candidates. The written examination will be of 300 marks. 150 questions will be asked. Each question will be of 2 marks. This time, the negative marking system has been abolished. Only candidates who pass the written examination will be able to participate in the physical test. Men will have to complete a 4.8-kilometer run in 25 minutes, and women will have to complete a 2.4-kilometer run in 14 minutes. After this, the final result will be announced.

stories.title: 'We have been together for 83 lifetimes’:Baba Neem Karoli says, 'If I take away your suffering, you will have to be reborn'
stories.summary: Kainchi Dham is known not only for its temple and ashram but also for the many mystical stories associated with the devoted followers of Baba Neem Karoli, who is also popularly known as Baba Neeb Karori. One such tale is that of Bareilly resident Kishan Chand Tiwari (K.C. Tiwari), whom Maharaj-ji is believed to have described as his companion through 83 lifetimes. According to an account published in Divya Anubhuti by Vijay Chhabria and Dr. Deepak Patwardhan, KC Tiwari was a distinguished scholar, a humble practitioner of yoga, and a school principal. Despite his academic achievements, he remained deeply devoted to spirituality. He firmly believed that mastering the mind and senses was essential for spiritual growth. Guided by this principle, he followed a life of strict discipline. He gave up grains and survived on a simple, satvic diet, which he considered the foundation of his vibrant and spiritually enriched life. Tears would flow during chanting of mantras Tiwari ji's devotion to Shiva was also a topic of discussion. On Mahashivratri, he would perform four uninterrupted pujas of three hours each. Daily chanting of the name with the rosary given by Maharajji and pranayama for hours was his regular spiritual practice. During mantra recitation and hymn chanting, he would become so emotionally overwhelmed that tears would stream from his eyes. Neeb Karoli Baba had deep faith in Tiwari ji's knowledge. Whenever any devotee came with spiritual doubts, Baba would often have Tiwari ji resolve them. Baba used to send foreign devotees to him to learn meditation yoga. Many times Baba himself would demonstrate their state of meditation and samadhi. It is said that with one touch, Baba would take them into deep samadhi. Once he was examined by a doctor. The doctor said that Tiwariji's body had completely disconnected from the external world, and he was in deep samadhi. Later, Baba himself brought him out of that state. Asked about illness - Why don't you remove my suffering Tiwariji suffered from a lung disease for a long time. During unbearable pain, he once asked Maharaj-ji, why don't you remove this suffering of mine? To this, Baba replied, Oh Kishan! I can end this suffering right now, but if your karmic debts are not cleared in this life, then you will have to take birth again to complete them. Do you want to fall into the cycle of birth and death again? After this, Baba reduced the intensity of his illness and taught him to patiently complete his karmic destiny. Once Tiwariji arrived at Kainchi Dham from Nainital and said somewhat angrily, why did you drag me here? Then Baba said with a smile, I don't drag anyone here. Our relationship is not of today, it is of the past 83 births. In the memoir, this has been described as a symbol of the spiritual relationship between guru and disciple across many lifetimes. Did not want to get married Kishanchandra Tiwari's childhood was spent in struggles. His parents passed away at a young age. Later, the aunt who raised him also passed away. Due to these circumstances, he had decided to remain unmarried for life, but once Baba took him to a family in Haldwani. Seeing the service-oriented nature of a young woman there, Baba decided that she would be Kishan's life partner. Tiwariji flatly refused to marry. At this, Baba said, Until you say yes, I will not leave from here. Finally, Tiwariji laid down a condition that Baba should take responsibility for his family and household life in writing. After which, Baba wrote on paper, "The responsibility of your life is mine." After this, he gave his consent for the marriage. Once in a Hanuman temple in Lucknow, Baba asked Tiwariji to perform Shiva worship. Tiwariji replied laughingly, "I will worship for four hours, and you will leave somewhere in between." When he was not convinced, Baba held his ears and gave his word that he would not get up from there until the worship was complete. It is said that after this, he sat in one place for the entire four hours. A temple was built where people were afraid to go According to the memoir, in the year 1961, Maharajji was staying at Dada Mukherjee's house in Allahabad. One night, around 11 o'clock, suddenly the door of his room opened. The scene that Dada Mukherjee saw outside left him stunned and amazed for life. Baba's body appeared much larger than normal. His arms were reaching down to his knees, and his form appeared like Hanumanji. Later, he also called his wife Kamala Didi. According to Tiwariji, the hill where Nainital's famous Hanumangarhi stands today was once a cremation ground for children. Local people had a fear of that place. Baba established an idol of Sankat Mochan Hanuman there and transformed that fear into devotion. Later, under his guidance, the Hanumangarhi temple was constructed, which is today counted among the major religious sites. When the leaf plates ran out at the feast At the time of the inauguration of the Hanumangarhi temple, preparations for a grand feast had been made. All arrangements were complete, but at the last moment, it was discovered that no arrangement had been made for leaf plates to serve the food. Everyone became worried. Just then, Baba pointed towards the road. After some time, a group of traders arrived there with thousands of leaf plates loaded on donkeys. They were passing through that same route on their way to the market. Devotees still remember this incident today as Baba's divine play. Another incident occurred during the bhandara. At night, the organisers informed that the ghee had run out. According to the memoir, Baba removed everyone from there and quietly asked Tiwariji to place two containers of water on the road. In the morning, when those containers were opened, they were filled with ghee. Later, Baba said with a smile, You people don't pay attention, the ghee was kept right here. Maharajji's famous American devotee, Krishna Das, was considered by Tiwariji as his eldest son. It is said that Baba himself gave him the name 'Krishna Das'. Tiwariji and his wife gave him affection like their own son. Later, Krishna Das wrote in his book "Chants of a Lifetime" that if he had not received the company of the Tiwari family, perhaps he would not even be alive. Holding prayer beads in hand, says child will not die In the final days of his life, Tiwariji was admitted to the hospital. During that time, his grandson went into a coma after a serious accident. Tiwariji took the prayer beads in his hand and said, when I pray to Maharaj-ji with undivided devotion, he hears my call. That child will not die. According to family members, after three days, the child regained consciousness. Tiwariji, who was staying at his daughter's house for health recovery, fell down one day during Brahma Muhurta and went into a coma. After three days, he regained consciousness. He spoke only three words to his daughter - I am fine. Just moments after this, he peacefully departed from his body. After his demise, his wife handed over that rosary to Krishnadas, which Maharajji himself had given to Tiwariji. With this, the tradition of name-remembrance continued forward. Dham was established on the banks of Shipra River in 1960 Kainchi Dham is located near Bhowali in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand. Baba Neem Karoli Maharaj established this ashram and Hanuman temple on the banks of the Shipra River in the 1960s. This place is famous across the country and abroad for its spiritual peace and natural beauty.

stories.title: Pre-monsoon rains to begin in UP today:Alert issued for 35 cities; Etawah hit by storm winds, 3 dead
stories.summary: Amid the intense heatwave in Uttar Pradesh, the weather is set to change significantly. The state is expected to witness the start of pre-monsoon rainfall activity from Wednesday. In the early hours of Wednesday, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Sambhal received rain accompanied by strong winds. However, bright sunshine continued in most other cities. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an alert for thunderstorms, rain, lightning, and hail in 35 districts on Wednesday. A heatwave alert has also been issued for 17 cities. According to the IMD, a new western disturbance will become active from June 11, which is expected to strengthen pre-monsoon activity across the state. Earlier on Tuesday, thunderstorms and strong winds caused significant damage in Chitrakoot, Etawah, Firozabad, and Sitapur. In Chitrakoot, the roof of the ₹4.5-crore Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Auditorium was blown away during the storm. In Etawah, a tin shed was blown off by winds reaching 100 kmph and fell on a woman. An elderly man also died after being crushed under a tree that collapsed onto a road. In Sitapur, near the Lucknow border, a tree was uprooted and fell on a highway, killing a sanitation worker trapped underneath. In Firozabad, one person died after an iron gate at an under-construction house collapsed. His wife and daughter sustained serious injuries in the incident. Authorities have advised residents to remain cautious as adverse weather conditions are expected to continue over the coming days. Senior scientist Atul Kumar Singh from Lucknow said: “Weather fluctuations will continue across Uttar Pradesh. While some areas are experiencing heatwave conditions, others are receiving thunderstorms and rain. A new western disturbance will become active from June 11, leading to an increase in pre-monsoon activities. Thunderstorms and rainfall are expected to continue until June 15-16. The monsoon is likely to enter the state by its scheduled date of June 20 and cover the entire state within 10 days.” Weather forecast for the next 5 days June 11: Pre-monsoon activities may begin across the state. Rain is likely in eastern Uttar Pradesh, while western Uttar Pradesh may continue to experience heatwave conditions. June 12: Thunderstorms and rain are likely across the state. Relief from heat and heatwave conditions is expected. June 13: Light rainfall is expected in both eastern and western Uttar Pradesh. Temperatures may drop by 3–4°C. June 14: Rain accompanied by thunder and lightning may occur across the state. Cool breezes are likely to provide relief from the heat. June 15: Strong winds are expected in eastern and western Uttar Pradesh, along with heavy rainfall. Relief from heatwave conditions is likely to continue.

stories.title: Ram Mandir theft case reaches PM Modi:BJP leader writes letter to PMO; Akhilesh asks, 'Who is the mastermind of 'Chadhava' scandal?'
stories.summary: Ayodhya BJP leader Dr. Rajnish Singh complained to Prime Minister Modi on Tuesday about the alleged theft of offerings at the Ram Temple. He has written a letter to the PMO demanding an impartial investigation. Meanwhile, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav has again raised the issue of alleged theft at the Ram Temple. He called it 'Chadhava Chori Kand' (Offering Theft Scandal) on X and demanded an impartial investigation and bringing out the truth. Akhilesh Yadav asked who are the people behind playing with the country's Sanatan faith? Who is protecting those allegedly stealing from the offerings? To whom are the threads of this entire matter connected, and who is responsible for this? The Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) on Wednesday sought a report from the Ram Temple Trust regarding claims that ₹7 crore from offerings made at the Ayodhya Ram Temple had been stolen, according to sources. The move comes after BJP leader Dr Rajneesh Singh wrote to the Prime Minister on Tuesday, demanding a CBI investigation into the matter. Meanwhile, Ram Temple Construction Committee Chairman Nripendra Mishra held a meeting with trust members on Tuesday. The meeting lasted for nearly four hours in a closed room within the Ram Temple complex. According to sources, discussions focused on the donation amount, its utilisation, and related financial records. The controversy began after former Samajwadi Party minister Pawan Pandey claimed on Sunday, June 7, that between ₹5 crore and ₹7.5 crore had been stolen from the Ram Temple’s donation collections. Akhilesh also alleged that the government's silence on the issue was suspicious and said the court should take cognisance of the matter. Akhilesh said - What is the problem in releasing CCTV? Akhilesh said what the problem is with making the CCTV footage public. He also raised questions about the role of private companies and asked who made the decision to involve private companies between the trust and government banks in sensitive work like counting of offerings. Former SP MLA and minister from Ayodhya, Pawan Pandey, claimed on Sunday, June 7, that ₹5-7 crore has been stolen from the offerings at Ram Mandir. If no theft has occurred, then the Trust's General Secretary Champat Rai should swear in the name of Lord Shri Ram and say that the allegations are false. If the matter is true, then an FIR should be filed. Earlier, Akhilesh had written on X that the government's silence is suspicious. The court should take suo motu cognizance of this matter. Trust General Secretary Champat Rai had called these allegations baseless and said that every penny is accounted for. Akhilesh wrote - BJP people across the country have been left speechless Akhilesh Yadav said, " No one understands what the trustees want to say. News of people involved in embezzlement being taken into custody is being broadcast in newspapers and TV channels''. First, the police say nothing, but later deny it. Seeing the public's outrage, BJP people across the country have been left speechless. Akhilesh was the first to raise the issue... 'Disappearance of rupees is shameful for temple trust' Akhilesh wrote in his X post on June 7, this is extremely sensitive news for devotees of Lord Ram across the world. Crores of rupees from Ram Mandir offerings have been found missing. Akhilesh also targeted the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust and the government. He wrote that the disappearance of crores of rupees is an extremely shameful situation for the temple trust. No one wants to come forward to give any clarification. The SP president demanded that the court take suo motu cognizance. He said this is directly related to the deep faith of the entire Sanatan society globally in Lord Ram. The government's silence is suspicious. Akhilesh also targeted Champat Rai Akhilesh also countered Champat Rai's clarification. Akhilesh wrote on X. The clarification itself is not clear. It seems this is a routine matter for them every week, and so very routine that they don't even consider it 'noteworthy' anymore. The facial expressions and body language are filled with desperation and disappointment. All members of the trust should be seated together and given a clarification, and CCTV evidence should be used for verification of figures. As soon as all trustees sit together, the truth will immediately come out, because not everyone among them is the same. When no particular person is at the center of this suspicion of manipulation, then what is the significance of any one person's clarification? It should also be clarified why it took so many hours for a 40-second clarification to come, and why even speaking for 1 minute in the name of clarification is proving to be so difficult. Like the state government's silence, this clarification is also suspicious. It seems as if verbal formality is being fulfilled in the name of clarification. The entire world's Sanatan society has become even more doubtful and hurt by this extremely weak clarification. Ayodhya BJP leader wrote letter to PM Modi Ayodhya BJP leader Dr. Rajnish Singh has written a letter to the Prime Minister. He said that Ram Mandir is the center of faith for crores of devotees. In such a situation, transparency is essential regarding any dispute or allegation related to offerings, donations, and temple administration. If the allegations are baseless, then the truth should be brought out through investigation, and if any irregularity has occurred, then strict action should be taken against the guilty. Know about the system of counting offerings at Ram Temple... Bank employees count the offerings at Ram Temple in the presence of Trust members. This work is done under CCTV surveillance. The donation amount is recorded in a register. Then it is kept in a locker built within the Ram Temple premises itself. The next day, the money is deposited in the bank. The Trust's main account is in the State Bank of India at Ayodhya Dham. The entire audit work of the offering amount is done under the supervision of TCS (Tata Consultancy Services). How much offering comes to the Ram Temple - this information is given only in the Trust's meeting. The last time information about offerings was given was in December 2025. What did the leaders say? Let's know...

stories.title: Karni Sena chief announces UP election plan:Says it's not a slave of BJP in upcoming polls; will contest on 50 seats
stories.summary: Karni Sena President Surajpal Singh's ('Ammu') aggressive stance has started a new stir in UP politics. Ammu announced that Karni Sena is not a slave of the BJP. It will field candidates for 50 seats in the upcoming assembly elections. He also attacked BJP ally SBSP chief Om Prakash Rajbhar by calling him 'incompetent' and his party Apna Dal a 'dream party'. On this, Apna Dal's National Vice President and UP government minister Ashish Patel warned that if such behavior is repeated, we will give such a response that there will be no way to escape. Meanwhile, OP Rajbhar called him mentally ill. According to political experts, Karni Sena is putting pressure on the BJP for power sharing. Even if it may not register a big victory in the elections, it will definitely make inroads into the BJP's upper caste vote bank. Read this report... First, know what the Karni Sena President said... Karni Sena National President Surajpal Singh 'Ammu' said in Shahjahanpur on June 7 - In the next Assembly elections, Karni Sena will field candidates on 50 seats. We are not slaves of the BJP. We will not do anyone's political slavery. When you make an incompetent person like Rajbhar a minister. You give seats to people of Apna Dal, Sapna Dal type. We have Brahmins and Baniyas with us. 36 communities are standing with us, can't we contest elections? Ashish Patel says, ‘They will not find a way to escape’ On being called incompetent, Cabinet Minister and National President of Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party Om Prakash Rajbhar says - Karni Sena President is mentally ill. What comment should be made about such people? Meanwhile, Cabinet Minister in the UP government, Ashish Patel, is quite angry about Ammu's comment on Apna Dal. He says that the oppressed, deprived society of UP has awakened. It knows how to respond to Karni Sena. This time, we are letting Karni Sena go, but if such an act is repeated, the people of the deprived society will give such a response that they won't even be able to find a way to escape. Karni Sena will only dent BJP Senior journalist Siddharth Kalhans says that all the office bearers of Karni Sena have been contesting elections from other parties. This is the first time that Karni Sena is making up its mind to contest elections itself. In the last 3 years, such faces have joined the Karni Sena who can contest elections. Now, there are not only Thakurs in Karni Sena. A storyteller from Ayodhya has been made the national spokesperson, who is a Brahmin. Similarly, other people have also been prepared. This will directly harm the BJP. There is full hope that they will field candidates. However, Karni Sena will not be able to get many votes. Whatever dent it makes, it will only be to the BJP. In Western UP, where there was a dispute between Jats and Thakurs over the installation of Mihirbhoj's statue, Karni Sena can put in more effort there. BJP can manage big leaders of Karni Sena Senior journalist Siddharth Kalhan explains that Karni Sena does the same kind of politics that the BJP and its various organizations have been doing till now. Karni Sena now wants participation in the government. This is why it is trying to put pressure on the BJP. In such a situation, if the BJP feels that Karni Sena can cause damage in the UP elections, then the party can manage its big leaders. Ammu came into limelight from 'Padmaavat' film controversy Karni Sena and its president Surajpal Singh 'Ammu' came into the limelight during the protest against the film 'Padmaavat' in 2017-18. The organization held demonstrations across the country, accusing the film of tampering with history. During this time, Ammu made controversial statements about actress Deepika Padukone and director Sanjay Leela Bhansali. Violence occurred in several places, including Gurugram. In January 2018, Ammu was arrested and sent to jail. Later, he resigned from the BJP. Ammu has often made aggressive statements on issues like Hindutva, Rajput pride, love jihad, and historical preservation. Ammu claims that his organization has the power to defeat or make anyone win. Karni Sena's old connection with controversies Karni Sena was founded in 2006 by Lokendra Singh Kalvi in Jaipur. It was named after Karni Mata, the clan deity of Rajasthan. Initially, this organization focused on the Rajput reservation and historical preservation. However, it soon came into the limelight by raising issues related to films and social matters.

stories.title: 49 gangs on police radar in Ghazipur:Whatsapp group of 300 goons created; Katra-gang leader considered himself 'Shri Prakash Shukla'
stories.summary: After the murder of a hotel businessman's son, the Khoda and Katra areas of Ghazipur have turned into a police camp. The leader of the 'Katra Gang' that carried out the incident, Shankar Pandey, used to portray himself as the notorious criminal 'Shri Prakash Shukla'. The gang's network operated through WhatsApp. About 300 boys associated with the gang would arrive with hockey sticks and clubs to beat people up on just one message. However, the administration has served a notice for bulldozer action at the house of Kamlesh Bind, who was killed in an encounter. Kamlesh is being considered the right-hand of gang leader Shankar Pandey. Meanwhile, the gang's main hideout is locked. Dainik Bhaskar reached the spot to know the complete situation. Read our ground report... From murder to encounter: Sehra on head 37 days ago, now mourning at home Kamlesh Bind, an accused in the Vineet Rai murder case, was killed in a police encounter on June 3. Just 37 days before this, his wedding had taken place. Kamlesh's house is in Khoda village, just 300 meters away from Bindu Hotel (where Vineet was murdered). Kamlesh's sister-in-law Anita Devi is the village head. To gather information about the members of the 'Katra Gang', our team first reached Kamlesh's house. At this time, the family is not being allowed to meet anyone. Police security has been deployed in a 500-meter area around the house. The reason behind this is the ongoing political rhetoric in the state over Kamlesh's encounter. We somehow managed to reach the family. There we found Kamlesh's brother, Sanjay Bind, sitting with a notice in his hand. We asked what the notice was about. He said that the department has issued us a show-cause notice regarding this house. We have been asked to respond by June 12. Regarding the Vinay murder case, Sanjay says - Kamlesh had no hand in it. When his name came up the next day, he had gone to relatives. His death has caused us great loss. I have faith in the government and administration. I just want them to take appropriate action and give us justice. They should not cause us further harm. Shankar's right hand Kamlesh had 7 cases against him Kamlesh Bind was the right-hand of Katra gang leader Shankar Pandey. He was often seen with him. The family members were unaware of what Kamlesh did outside. Kamlesh had 7 cases registered against him, including murder, attempt to murder, kidnapping, assault, and threatening. Kamlesh's mother, Lakshmina Devi, says that my son was innocent. When his name came up in the murder in the morning, he fled from home. The policemen came and took away both my daughters-in-law. They kept them sitting in the police station for 5 days. They released them around 2 AM on the night of my son's encounter. We are not thieves or criminals, so people came after Kamlesh's death. Someone threw a stone, then they entered my house and beat everyone. Regarding Kamlesh's crimes, Lakshmina Devi says that earlier, there was a case of fighting and quarreling. My son didn't commit any riot or murder. A wedding procession had come 2 years ago, and there was a fight in that. That's why these people are taking revenge and got my son's name written. Smuggler father locked in Bengal jail, son is Ghazipur's gangster The house of the main accused, Shankar Pandey, is also at some distance from the hotel. These days, the house is locked. People around are afraid to talk about Shankar. One big reason for this is that the police have already interrogated more than 30 people in the area. People say that Shankar's father, Ravisekhar Pandey, is a big smuggler of narcotics. He has been arrested in a heroin case. He is locked in a Bengal jail. Mother Poonam Pandey and two brothers used to live at home, but right now everyone has fled. The other 2 accused in the murder, Sonu Yadav and Alok Dubey, are also from this same area. We reached Sonu's house. It was found that his family, meaning his parents, brothers, and sisters, don't live here; only he used to live here. This is the reason why this house was the main hideout of the Katra gang. Gang members used to have liquor and chicken parties here. Several cases are also registered against Sonu. He has been to jail many times. People around narrate an incident off-camera. They say - Last month, there was a fight between Shankar and Sonu. Shankar had beaten Sonu badly. He had threatened that leave Ghazipur, otherwise I will kill you. After this, Sonu was not seen in this area. However, how much truth there is in this, only the police can know. Alok Dubey's house is also locked. Like Shankar, he too has installed CCTVs in his house. No one else in the area has cameras installed. Alok used to call himself Nawab. He has created an ID with this name on Instagram as well. Alok's father, Laxman Dubey, is a security guard. Alok is the only son. His two sisters are married. Cases of assault and robbery are also registered against Alok. Molestation of female constable, assaulted family member on protest A lot of information was received about the Katra gang in Ghazipur city. About 300 boys were connected to the gang's WhatsApp group. Even in minor disputes among boys, as soon as a message was sent to the group, 30-35 boys would reach the spot with hockey sticks. Something similar happened on February 25, 2024. In the Badrichand Pokhra area, a woman constable was going to Prayagraj with her husband, brother, and nephew. Then 2 criminals from the Katra gang started harassing the woman constable. When the husband and brother objected, the boys sent a message to the gang. 30-40 boys gathered at the spot. They beat up the woman constable and her family, then fled after looting their mobile phones. A case was registered, but nothing happened. This is just one example of the audacity of the Katra gang. Teasing girls, surrounding and beating up anyone in case of an argument, forcibly extorting money from traders - this was the gang's main work. Shankar Pandey was its leader. He studied from the CBSE board. He had formed the gang during his school days. The boys in the group would chase the girls. Sometimes they would go to their homes. When family members objected, they would beat them up. In the city itself, these people had harassed the daughter of a BSF jawan. When he complained to the police, these boys backed off. Shankar would portray himself like Shri Prakash Shukla. He posted pictures of Shri Prakash on social media several times. He would move around in convoys of vehicles. He would call himself a lion, the king of Ghazipur, Bahubali. Every post had the same caption: "Just remember me in your prayers". After the caption, there was also a lion emoji. After this, his dominance in the area became such that many people would pay him money to get their enemies beaten up. This work and illegal extortion had become Shankar's main business. Ghazipur Police's 'Operation Vajrapaat', 49 gangs found active in the city After the murder of Vineet Rai, Ghazipur Police started tightening the noose on the Katra gang and other gangs active in the city. By conducting Operation Vajrapaat, 49 gangs were identified. These include gangs like Mahakal, 315, Farsa, Buddhan, Yadav, Shere Purvanchal, Bhurkuda, and Hunter. A total of 401 members were spotted in these. 39 cases were registered, and 11 arrests were made. However, not a single member of the Katra gang was arrested. Police had identified more than 110 gangs last year as well, but this year it was said that many gangs are no longer active.

stories.title: 4 critical as balcony collapses near Banke Bihari Temple:9 injured, panic in crowded lane; neighbour says monkey's jump triggered cave-in
stories.summary: A dilapidated balcony of a house suddenly collapsed on Tuesday evening in Lane No. 5 near the Banke Bihari Temple in Vrindavan, injuring nine people. Four of the injured are reported to be in critical condition. All the victims have been admitted to hospital for treatment. The incident occurred at the house of Sudhir Goswami. According to neighbour Shivkumar, the balcony had developed cracks earlier and reportedly collapsed after a monkey jumped on it. Strong winds reportedly preceded the collapse Local residents said strong winds were blowing in the area when the balcony gave way and fell onto the crowded lane below. Debris from the structure spread across the street, injuring several devotees passing through the area. After the collapse, panic broke out as people rushed to safety. Shopkeepers and local residents reached the spot and helped rescue those trapped under the debris. Police and administrative officials also arrived shortly after being informed and shifted the injured to hospitals. Security tightened in temple area Following the incident, security has been increased around the temple area. Additional police personnel have been deployed to regulate the movement of devotees. The administration has also begun inspecting old and dilapidated buildings in the vicinity to prevent similar incidents in the future. The accident has raised concerns among devotees and local residents, who have called for regular structural inspections of old buildings in crowded areas. Eyewitness: “My pilgrim was trapped under the debris” Eyewitness Manish Goswami said the balcony collapsed between 6 pm and 6:15 pm. He said a mobile alert had been received a few minutes earlier, and while people were discussing it, they suddenly heard a loud crashing sound. He said Lakshman Vaishney, who had come from Aligarh for darshan, was trapped beneath the debris and was later admitted to hospital. DM and SSP visit hospital District Magistrate Chandra Prakash Singh and Senior Superintendent of Police Shlok Kumar visited Ram Krishna Mission Charitable Trust Hospital and met the injured. They assured all possible assistance to the victims and their families. Injured persons identified The injured have been identified as: Neighbour says balcony had cracks Neighbour Dinesh Goswami said the balcony had been cracked for a long time and collapsed after a monkey jumped across it. He said several people were trapped under the debris when it fell. Police officer: Devotees diverted after incident Sadar Circle Officer Pritam Pal Singh said the accident occurred near Gate No. 4 of the temple area. The injured were immediately taken by ambulance to the District Hospital and RK Mission Hospital. He added that devotees were temporarily stopped from entering the affected route and diverted through alternative paths while rescue and clearance work continued. Family member blames old structure A relative of one of the injured said the family was returning after offering prayers when strong winds began blowing. According to the family member, monkeys were jumping on an old balcony, which then collapsed and injured several people, including his daughter. The accident took place around 150 metres from the temple.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:CM Yogi links Ramayana to ‘land jihad’, cites Ram’s ideals; India deploys 12 nuclear warheads for 1st time more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. India deploys 12 nuclear warheads for 1st time India is believed to have expanded its nuclear arsenal in 2025 while continuing to develop new nuclear delivery systems, according to the latest assessment by the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI). 2. Yogi links Ramayana to ‘land jihad’, cites Ram’s ideals Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath invoked Ramayana episodes during a Ramkatha event in Lucknow, describing Maricha and Subahu as Ravana’s agents engaged in “land jihad”. He said Lord Ram’s life and commitment to women’s dignity offer an ideal example to counter “love jihad”. 3. Akhilesh mocks Nandi after expressway authority charge withdrawn Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav mocked Uttar Pradesh minister Nand Gopal Gupta Nandi after UPEIDA was moved out of his department. Akhilesh said Nandi was “half-finished” and claimed the BJP may replace candidates on several Assembly seats ahead of the next elections. 4. Manipur villages impose new condition for security forces' entry Ethnic violence has been continuing in Manipur for nearly three years, and complete peace has yet to be restored in the state. On Monday, a Kuki militant group opened fire in Pongringlong Rongmei Naga village in Kangpokpi district. 5. Police exam candidates foil rape bid, accused arrested after encounter Two women travelling to Raebareli for a police constable recruitment exam escaped an alleged rape attempt after fiercely resisting an auto-rickshaw driver in Lucknow. The accused, identified as Haseeb, later fled but was arrested following a police encounter in which he suffered a leg injury. 6. Early UP polls buzz grows as parties shift into campaign mode Speculation is growing that Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections could be held months ahead of schedule due to the upcoming census and board examinations. With political parties accelerating preparations, the debate has intensified over whether an early poll would benefit the BJP or the Samajwadi Party. 7. US court scraps Trump’s $100,000 H-1B visa fee plan A US federal judge has struck down Trump’s requirement that applicants pay a $100,000 fee for H-1B visas, ruling that the President lacked the legal authority to impose the measure on a programme widely used by US companies to recruit highly skilled foreign workers. 8. Property dispute clouds Khan Sir as relatives level serious allegations A property dispute involving popular educator Khan Sir has surfaced in Deoria, with a relative alleging links to criminal activities and the recent Patna coaching centre firing case. The controversy follows police action against two bodyguards after the June 2 shooting incident. 9. Accompanying wife to police exam, youth shot dead by brother-in-law A 24-year-old man was allegedly shot dead by his brother-in-law in Saharanpur while accompanying his wife to a police recruitment exam. The accused reportedly opposed the couple’s love marriage and opened fire after an argument when his sister refused to return home with him. 10. Rohit Sharma, Hardik Pandya gets green light for Afghanistan ODI Team India has received a major boost ahead of the upcoming three-match ODI series against Afghanistan, with star all-rounder Hardik Pandya being declared fully fit for selection and former India captain Rohit Sharma has also cleared the fitness test and received the green light for the ODI series.

stories.title: 'Personal liberty cannot be violated':Allahabad HC orders ₹2 lakh compensation for 8-day illegal detention, questions Police practices
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court on Tuesday strongly criticised the misuse of provisions related to apprehension of breach of peace under the Commissionerate system, observing that personal liberty is paramount and no innocent citizen can be sent to jail without following due legal process. A division bench comprising Justices Siddharth and Vinay Kumar Dwivedi made the remarks while hearing a petition filed by Mansoor Ahmad alias Lallu. The court found that Mansoor had been illegally kept in judicial custody for eight days and termed it a blatant violation of his fundamental right to personal liberty. Court orders Rs 2 lakh compensation Taking serious note of the illegal detention, the High Court directed the Uttar Pradesh government to pay Rs 2 lakh compensation to Mansoor within six weeks. The bench observed that ACP Bara and the Special Executive Magistrate had grossly violated Sections 126, 135 and 170 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS). Instead of giving the accused an opportunity to furnish a personal bond to maintain peace, authorities directly sent him to jail. The court further directed that after a departmental inquiry, the compensation amount should be recovered from the salary of ACP Ved Vyas Mishra if his responsibility is established. Mishra is currently posted in Prayagraj. High Court questions Prayagraj Police functioning The court expressed concern over the functioning of the Prayagraj Police Commissionerate, stating that magisterial powers granted to police authorities were being misused. According to the bench, people are being jailed for extended periods on the mere apprehension of a breach of peace, even though the law does not permit such prolonged detention. The court directed the Police Commissioner of Prayagraj to submit a compliance report on the order by September 14, 2026. Court cites earlier Ghaziabad judgment Referring to its recent judgment involving the Ghaziabad Commissionerate, the High Court reiterated that in such cases authorities should generally obtain a personal bond and avoid unnecessary detention. The bench noted that if illegal detention exceeds 24 hours, compensation of Rs 25,000 per day should be awarded to the affected individual. The court clarified that while the state government would initially pay the compensation, it would subsequently conduct a departmental inquiry and recover the amount from the responsible officer if misconduct is proven. 2,325 people detained in two-and-a-half years The High Court examined records submitted by the Chief Judicial Magistrate of Prayagraj and found a concerning pattern. According to the records, 283 people were detained under similar provisions in 2024, 1,321 in 2025, and 721 people so far in 2026. In total, 2,325 individuals were detained over the last two-and-a-half years. The bench noted that many of them were kept in custody for periods ranging from one week to 20 days, despite legal safeguards against such detention. Court recalls earlier ruling on illegal police custody The High Court also referred to a recent case in which it observed that some police officers routinely violate citizens' rights believing their actions will go unchallenged. In that case, a bench of Justices JJ Munir and Sanjeev Kumar awarded interim compensation of Rs 25,000 to Prayagraj resident Matambar Mishra, who was illegally detained in police custody for 24 hours. The court observed that it is the judiciary's duty to enforce citizens' constitutional and legal rights whenever violations are brought before it. Domestic dispute led to illegal detention According to court records, on November 26, 2022, Matambar Mishra returned home from his fields when then police outpost in-charge Sub-Inspector Surya Prakash Dubey allegedly entered his house and dragged him outside. Mishra, who was wearing only a kurta and lungi at the time, was taken to the police station without any explanation and kept in a lock-up for 24 hours. The petition alleged that the officer demanded a bribe of Rs 20,000 for his release. The action was reportedly taken on the basis of a domestic violence complaint lodged by Mishra's brother's daughter-in-law. The High Court had held that such actions amounted to a serious infringement of personal liberty and constitutional rights.

stories.title: Youth accompanying wife to police exam shot dead:Brother-in-law fires at point-blank range in Saharanpur, love marriage sparked feud
stories.summary: A 24-year-old man was shot dead allegedly by his brother-in-law in Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur on Tuesday. The victim, Shivkumar, had married a woman from his village in a love marriage four months ago, a relationship reportedly opposed by her family. According to police, Shivkumar had travelled from Shamli to Saharanpur to accompany his wife, Aakanksha, for a police recruitment examination. After the exam ended, the couple was preparing to return home when the incident took place in the Rampur Maniharan area. Brother-in-law stopped car, argument turned violent Police said Aakanksha's brother, Manjeet, intercepted the couple's car outside the examination centre. He allegedly asked his sister to return home with him, but she refused. This led to a heated argument between Manjeet and Shivkumar. During the confrontation, the accused allegedly pulled out a pistol and fired a shot at Shivkumar's temple from close range. The victim collapsed on the spot with critical injuries. The accused fled immediately after the shooting. Local people informed the police, who rushed Shivkumar to hospital, where doctors declared him dead. See pictures related to the incident- Wife alleges family had been threatening husband since marriage Aakanksha said her family had been threatening Shivkumar ever since they got married. "I have completed my BA and am preparing for police recruitment. My exam was at Gochar Inter College in Rampur Maniharan. My husband brought me there by car and waited outside while I appeared for the exam," she said. After the examination, she returned to the vehicle and the couple was about to leave when her brother arrived with several associates. "He asked me to come home, but I refused. He started threatening us with a pistol. When he tried to force me out of the car, my husband objected. They argued, and then my brother suddenly shot Shivkumar in the temple," she alleged. Victim had recently secured government job offer The deceased, Shivkumar, was a resident of Khedi Bairagi village in Shamli district. He had completed MSc and LLB degrees and had received an appointment letter for a position in the SSF on March 3. However, he had not yet joined the service. Doctors said the gunshot wound caused severe bleeding, leading to his death. Police searching for accused Police have launched a search operation to arrest the accused brother-in-law. Further investigation into the case is underway.
