stories.title: Yogi invokes Ramayana to target 'land jihad':Calls Maricha and Subahu Ravana's agents; says Ram's life counters 'love jihad'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday invoked episodes from the Ramayana to draw parallels with what he described as "love jihad" and "land jihad" while addressing a gathering at Jagadguru Rambhadracharya's Shri Ramkatha in Lucknow. Speaking on the ninth and final day of the religious discourse, Yogi said Lord Ram's commitment to protecting the dignity of women offered an example for contemporary society. "Bhagwan Shri Ram worked for women's dignity. In today's times, it is an ideal example to stop love jihad," he said, adding that "there is hardly any Indian who has India in their DNA and does not believe in Shri Ram". Referring to the Ramayana, the Chief Minister said Ravana's rule symbolised destructive forces. He said Khar and Dushana had occupied the Dandakaranya region, while Tadaka had spread terror up to Buxar. "Whenever negative forces emerge, they bring only destruction," he said. Yogi went on to describe the actions of Khar-Dushana and Maricha-Subahu as a form of "land jihad", claiming that they drove saints and sages away from their places and occupied their land. "What were Khar-Dushana and Maricha-Subahu doing? They too were working with Ravana in a campaign of land jihad," he said. The Chief Minister also urged people to go beyond merely listening to Ramkatha. "Ramkatha is not only meant to be heard. It should be understood and imbibed," he said. Earlier, Yogi felicitated Jagadguru Rambhadracharya with a shawl. During the event, the seer was seen speaking to the Chief Minister for about a minute before presenting him with a gift taken from a small pouch. The nine-day Ramkatha concluded on Tuesday. Look at 3 pictures- Four key takeaways from Yogi Adityanath's address at Lucknow Ramkatha 1. 'Those who opposed Ram were destroyed' Invoking characters from the Ramayana, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said negative forces emerge in every era and must be confronted by the forces of righteousness. "When Lord Ram stepped out of Ayodhya for the first time, he encountered Tadaka, who was inspired by Ravana. Wrong attracts wrong," Yogi said. He argued that those who embraced Ram's ideals prospered, while those who opposed him met destruction. Referring to figures such as Maricha and Ravana, he said they were born into powerful families and privileged systems but perished because they "betrayed Ram". In contrast, Yogi said, figures such as Hanuman and Vibhishana attained reverence through their devotion to Ram. "Whoever made Ram the ideal of their life attained welfare. Whoever opposed Ram found no place on this earth," he said. 2. 'India cannot be a dharamshala for those without loyalty to the nation' The Chief Minister said people who lack loyalty and faith in India cannot be expected to respect the country's values and traditions. "For those who do not have loyalty towards India and do not have faith in India, this land cannot be a dharamshala," he said. Yogi also warned against attempts to divide society along religious and caste lines. Referring to Jagadguru Rambhadracharya's discourse, he urged people to live according to the ideals of Lord Ram and Lord Shiva rather than merely worshipping them. "The power of saints is meant to unite society and take everyone forward," he said. 3. 'There is hardly any Indian who does not believe in Shri Ram' Yogi said the Ram Janmabhoomi movement was sustained for centuries because saints across the country treated it as a matter of faith rather than personal gain. "All revered saints made Ram Janmabhoomi a matter of life and death. They did not do it for any benefit, but for Shri Ram," he said. According to the Chief Minister, Lord Ram remains a unifying force capable of connecting people across regions. He noted that the movement linked to Ram Janmabhoomi continued in one form or another for nearly five centuries. "There is hardly any Indian who has India in their DNA and does not believe in Shri Ram," he said. 4. 'Rambhadracharya is doing today what Tulsidas did in medieval India' Drawing a comparison between Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and the 16th-century poet-saint Tulsidas, Yogi said both played a role in awakening social consciousness through devotion to Lord Ram. "Tulsidas united society, inspired public consciousness and spread the message of Ram bhakti across North India. The same work is being carried out today by Jagadguru Rambhadracharya," he said. The Chief Minister also highlighted Rambhadracharya's role in establishing a university for persons with disabilities in Chitrakoot, describing it as the first institution of its kind in the country. Despite his responsibilities as Chancellor, Yogi said, Rambhadracharya continues to narrate the Ramkatha with the objective of encouraging people to follow the ideals of Maryada Purushottam Lord Ram. "If people follow the conduct and ideals of Lord Ram, it will bring immense welfare to the nation," he said.

stories.title: 'No ticket, and he will be finished':Akhilesh mocks Nandi, day after UPEIDA responsibility was withdrawn
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav took a swipe at Uttar Pradesh minister Nand Gopal Gupta 'Nandi' after the state government withdrew his responsibility for the Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority (UPEIDA). In a post on X on Tuesday, Akhilesh said, "He has been halved now. If he does not get a ticket in the Assembly elections, he will be completely wiped out." He also questioned the government's move, saying that after the construction of expressways and completion of the alleged "corruption targets", there was no point in removing him now. The Uttar Pradesh government on Monday decided to remove UPEIDA from the Industrial Development Department and place it under the Infrastructure and Industrial Development Department. With the change, all matters related to expressway construction and development will now be directly overseen by Yogi Adityanath. Until now, project proposals, budget-related files and approvals linked to UPEIDA were routed through Industrial Development Minister Nand Gopal Gupta 'Nandi'. Under the new arrangement, these files will be processed directly through the Chief Minister's Office, giving the CM direct control over decisions related to expressway projects and development work. Know what Akhilesh Yadav said Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav claimed that the BJP is considering changing candidates on all Assembly seats in Prayagraj after losing the Lok Sabha seat there. In a post on X, Akhilesh said the BJP believes its MLAs and candidates were focused on personal gains rather than public service, which led to the party losing the parliamentary seat. He alleged that a similar formula would be applied to all 43 Lok Sabha constituencies in Uttar Pradesh won by the INDIA alliance. Akhilesh further claimed that the BJP may also replace candidates in 9-10 seats where, according to him, the party won through "manipulation and certificates" rather than votes. He said this could result in candidate changes on nearly 225 Assembly seats. The SP chief also claimed that many sitting BJP MLAs are unwilling to contest the next election as they do not see a realistic chance of defeating the PDA (Pichhda, Dalit and Alpsankhyak) alliance. He alleged that BJP's traditional voter base has shrunk significantly. He added that several BJP legislators would prefer to save their resources rather than spend money on what they see as a losing election. Akhilesh also asserted that the BJP would lose power and would not return to government again. Why did the government make the change? UPDA was formed in 2007 UPDA was established on December 27, 2007, for building expressways in the state and developing industrial corridors. In subsequent years, its role became primarily focused on the construction of expressways and large infrastructure projects. Nandi also opened a front against the former Chief Secretary Nand Gopal Nandi had also opened a front against the then Chief Secretary Manoj Kumar Singh last year. He had complained to Delhi and lobbied against giving him a service extension. The Government of India did not give Manoj Kumar Singh a service extension. However, CM Yogi had appointed him as the Vice Chairman of the Transformation Commission. Nandi was stripped of the post of Minister in-charge of Banda 5 days ago The Yogi government had made a major reshuffle in the districts of minister in-charges about 5 days ago. During this time, the minister in-charge of Banda district was also changed. Dinesh Pratap Singh was made the minister in-charge of Banda district. Before this, Nand Gopal Gupta 'Nandi' was the minister in-charge of Banda district, who was removed. Now know about Minister Nandi

stories.title: UP Board copies will be opened for scrutiny under CCTV:Inspection of around 10,000 copies to be conducted; 4-member committee formed
stories.summary: The scrutiny work of answer sheets for dissatisfied students of the UP Board is starting. According to UP Board guidelines, the scrutiny work is to be done under CCTV surveillance. The scrutiny will be conducted in the control room set up at the Regional Office Varanasi of the Board of Secondary Education. More than eight thousand answer sheets in Intermediate and more than 1,600 answer sheets in High School are to be scrutinized. This work has to be completed by June 15. Regional Additional Secretary Bhaskar Mishra informed that complete transparency is being maintained in the scrutiny work; for this purpose, this work is to be done under camera surveillance. Apart from this, a four-member team has also been constituted, which will be present there during the scrutiny. The marks entered on each copy will be duly verified. If it appears that there has been any error in entering the numbers, it will be separated and placed before all four members of the committee. All four members will also have to sign on it. After this, it will be sent to the Additional Secretary. Teachers of the concerned subject will also be available so that they can duly evaluate the copies. The copy will be sent to UP Board headquarters, Prayagraj. Marksheets will be available in the last week of June UP Board students will have to wait longer for the results. Marksheets may be available in the last week of this month, June. This is because many students have applied for corrections in the marksheets. There are 4,697 applications from about 10 districts affiliated with the Varanasi regional office, which include different types of corrections. In some cases, there are mistakes in the student's name, while in others, there are errors in the mother's and father's names. Not only this, but the gender of many students has been changed. Now, students have submitted applications for corrections in this. The highest number of applications received was 1,275 for name corrections. Apart from this, 1,139 applications were received for changing the father's name, 974 for changing the mother's name, and 786 for changing the date of birth. Similarly, there are 92 such students whose gender has been entered incorrectly. 431 people have had changes in their photographs.

stories.title: Police recruitment exam conducted at 44 centers in Gorakhpur:Entry begins on 2nd day, monitoring being done through binoculars and CCTV
stories.summary: The second day of the Uttar Pradesh Police Constable Recruitment Examination began on Tuesday in Gorakhpur. Entry of candidates at the examination centres started from 8 AM in the morning. The first shift examination will be conducted from 10 AM to 12 PM, while the second shift examination will run from 3 PM to 5 PM. Keeping security arrangements in view, the police administration has maintained surveillance at every nook and corner through binoculars and CCTV. More than 1.16 lakh candidates to appear in examination over 3 days The examination is being conducted on June 8, 9, and 10 at 44 examination centres in the district. During this period, a total of 1,16,784 candidates will participate in the examination. Arrangements have been made for 19,464 candidates to sit in each shift. Strict security arrangements, STF and surveillance teams active The administration has made comprehensive security arrangements to conduct the examination in a fair, transparent and peaceful manner. An additional police force has been deployed at the examination centres. Besides this, STF, Crime Branch and surveillance teams have also been activated so that any attempt to copy, fraud or any other malpractice can be prevented in time. Instructions to reach examination centre one hour in advance Candidates have been instructed to reach the examination centre at least one hour before the scheduled time. Officials have clarified that no candidate will be allowed entry into the centre after the examination begins. Therefore, it is necessary to arrive on time. More than 10 thousand candidates remained absent on 1st day On Monday, the first day of the examination, a total of 38,928 candidates were supposed to appear in both shifts, but only 28,237 candidates reached the examination centres. Thus, a total of 10,691 candidates did not participate in the examination. In the first shift, 14,037 candidates appeared out of 19,464 candidates, while 5,427 candidates remained absent. In the second shift, 14,200 candidates out of 19,464 candidates came to take the examination, and 5,264 candidates skipped the exam. Surveillance increased at railway stations and bus stands Considering the large number of candidates arriving in Gorakhpur, security arrangements and surveillance have been increased at railway stations, bus stands, and other major public places. Police and administration are continuously monitoring the arrangements to ensure that candidates do not face any kind of inconvenience. Arrangement of help desk and holding area at railway station A special holding area has been created at the railway station premises for the convenience of examinees. Help desks have also been set up. Teachers, along with police personnel, are deployed here, to help candidates reach their examination centres and provide information about the respective schools. Instructions to provide train information, ambulance and fire brigade were also deployed Police personnel have been instructed to assist candidates by providing information about trains and platforms. Additionally, arrangements for ambulance and fire brigade have also been made at the railway station to deal with any emergency situation. Administration claims examination being conducted peacefully The administration says that so far, the examination is being conducted in a peaceful and organised manner. Security agencies are continuously monitoring, and necessary arrangements have been made at all centres, so that the examination can be completed in a completely fair and transparent manner.

stories.summary: The case involving the alleged misbehaviour with a Haryanvi dancer during a stage performance in Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, continues to intensify. Hathras police have registered a case against an unidentified man and launched an investigation. However, the dancer claims that the person who allegedly misbehaved with her has still not been arrested. Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar, the dancer said, “Hathras police have called me to the police station again on June 11. The police have assured me that the accused will be identified and arrested soon. I will wait until June 15. If the accused is not arrested by then, I will die by suicide.” She also said- Respect is most important for me. Where I don't get respect, I won't perform there. The dancer had come to perform at a birthday celebration in Hathras on June 3. It is alleged that during the event, a man came on stage and misbehaved with her. He also touched her waist. After this, the dancer slapped that man. Know what the dancer said; I will not sit at home accepting defeat The dancer said, “Hathras Police has released a video claiming that a person has been arrested, but that individual is linked to the event’s organising committee. I have no dispute with any member of the committee, nor do I hold them responsible for the incident. If proper action is not taken at the police station level, I will write to the Home Minister. If required, I will also approach the National Commission for Women and other concerned authorities with complaints. I am not prepared to accept defeat and remain silent at home.” Action will be taken against those making videos against He said that after this controversy, there has been a rapid increase in the number of social media followers. Some people are calling it a publicity stunt, but such things don't matter to me. Some people are spreading rumors by making wrong videos and reels against me. I will take legal action against them, too. Have to think even before leaving home The dancer further said, "I have been under a lot of stress since this incident. The videos being made against me on social media are also increasing my mental pressure. I am a stage artist, but that doesn't mean anyone can come on stage and behave indecently or try to molest. This incident has affected my confidence, and many times I have to think even before stepping out of the house." Won't attend programs if not given respect She said that she has several live shows scheduled in Rajasthan and Haryana. She also has a program in Rajasthan on June 14. The dancer said, "People who like my programs will keep inviting me. But if someone thinks that my respect can be compromised because I am an artist, then I am not willing to attend such programs. Respect comes first for me. Where I don't get respect, I won't go there." Artists should come forward and raise their voice The dancer said that such incidents have happened with many stage artists before as well. Artists should openly raise their voice in such cases and fight for their respect. Haryanvi actress Pooja Hudda has called and extended her support. Apart from this, she is receiving cooperation and support from many other people.

stories.title: Rape attempt on girls travelling for police recruitment exam:Both resisted fiercely and fled the spot; Lucknow police caught in encounter
stories.summary: 2 female candidates travelling to Raebareli for the police constable recruitment examination narrowly escaped an alleged rape attempt in Lucknow after an auto-rickshaw driver reportedly took them to a deserted location instead of the Alambagh bus station. According to police, the driver picked up the two friends from Charbagh but diverted the vehicle to an isolated area, where he allegedly molested and assaulted them. The women resisted fiercely. One pushed the accused, while the other bit his finger and raised an alarm. At that moment, a passerby happened to be crossing the area. Seeing him, the accused fled from the spot. The passerby informed the police, who reached the scene and later helped the two candidates board a train to Raebareli so they could appear for their examination. Police formed three teams to trace the accused and examined CCTV footage from the area. Based on the investigation, the suspect was identified as Haseeb, a resident of Hardoi. Late on Monday night, when police attempted to arrest him, he allegedly opened fire. In the ensuing exchange, he sustained a bullet injury to his leg. He was taken into custody and admitted to Rani Laxmi Bai Hospital for treatment. The two women, residents of Lakhimpur Kheri, had an examination scheduled in Raebareli on Monday. They had arrived in Lucknow a day earlier and were staying with relatives in the Madiyaon area. See, 3 photos Here is the sequence of events in the case: According to the FIR, at around 3:30 AM on Monday, the two candidates reached Charbagh Railway Station from Madiyaon. From there, they hired an auto-rickshaw to reach Alambagh Bus Station, where they were supposed to board a bus for Raebareli. The driver allegedly told them that the usual route was blocked and diverted the auto towards the Para police station area. He then took the two women to a deserted location near Ramlila Maidan and allegedly attempted to force himself on them. When the women resisted, he allegedly assaulted them, behaved indecently and caused injuries. The two candidates fought back, raised an alarm, pushed the accused away, and one of them bit his finger in an effort to escape. At that moment, a passerby happened to be crossing the area. Seeing him, the accused abandoned the auto-rickshaw and fled from the spot. The passerby immediately informed the police. Police officers reached the location and escorted the two women to Charbagh Railway Station. They were then sent to Raebareli so they could appear for their examination. After returning from the exam, the victims filed a complaint, based on which a case was registered against the auto-rickshaw driver. Following the recording of their statements, the two women were handed over to their family members. Police examined via CCTV DCP West Kamlesh Dixit said that police examined CCTV footage from cameras installed along the route between Charbagh and Para to identify the accused. Based on the footage, the suspect was identified as Haseeb. According to the police, information was received late on Monday night that Haseeb was near the Munnu Kheda culvert. A police team moved in and surrounded the area, but the accused allegedly tried to escape towards a canal bridge. When officers attempted to stop him, he allegedly opened fire on the police team. In the retaliatory action, Haseeb sustained a bullet injury to his leg and was arrested. During questioning, police found that Haseeb is a habitual offender with a criminal background. Accused committed similar crime in Hardoi in 2024 Police said the accused had committed a similar crime in Hardoi in 2024. In that case, he allegedly took a woman to a secluded location in his auto-rickshaw and raped her. He was arrested and had previously served time in jail in connection with that offence.

stories.title: Hotel businessman murdered over revenge, not extortion money:Father says, 'I sent Shankar to jail, he took my son’s life, police encounter justified'
stories.summary: The murder of Ghazipur hotel businessman Vineet Rai was allegedly not driven solely by a ₹1 crore extortion demand. Investigators are also looking at a two-year-old grudge linked to the case. According to Vineet’s father, the main accused, Shankar Pandey, had earlier been beaten at Vineet’s Bindu Hotel. He said, “I was the one who handed Shankar over to the police, but I never imagined that he would take my son’s life.” He also said the police acted appropriately by carrying out an encounter against the accused and added that the family does not know the other members of the gang. Eleven days have passed since Vineet’s murder, but Uttar Pradesh Police is yet to arrest the three other accused in the case. A reward of ₹1 lakh each has been announced for information leading to their capture. The case has also triggered political reactions in Uttar Pradesh, with leaders from the Samajwadi Party and Congress visiting the family to express support and meet the bereaved relatives. The Dainik Bhaskar team spoke with the victim's family. Terror persists even after 10 days near Vineet's house On the night of May 29, around 11 PM, Vineet Rai, the elder son of hotel businessman Alok Rai, was murdered in Phoolnpur, Ghazipur. Vineet was shot 4 times at the hotel gate. 4 criminals on 2 bikes had fled. The terror of the manner in which this incident was carried out persists even after 10 days. When we reached there, silence prevailed throughout the area. Police personnel were visible everywhere. Vineet's family lives in Ashtabhuji Colony. We reached there, having come to meet an acquaintance's family. Inside the house, we met his father, Alok Rai. He says that we only want the Katra gang to be eliminated. The criminals associated with them should be arrested. We asked - One criminal has been encountered. What do you want next? Alok says, ‘The police have to see all this, and the police will decide according to their judgment. We are businessmen; we want peace in the area. The police are conducting raids. We have complete faith in CM Yogi’. Now that incident, in revenge for which Vineet was murdered The incident is from February 2024. It was the wedding of Harshit, son of Alok Rai's sister Gudiya. The wedding was taking place at Bindu Hotel. That day, Shankar and his companions had come to the hotel. There was a fight with the staff over taking beer from the bar to drink. The staff had beaten up Shankar. A video of Shankar was also made. In it, Shankar was seen folding his hands and apologizing to people. He was saying that such a mistake would not happen again. For the hotel staff, the matter ended there. But this was not the complete truth. Vandalism at hotel, Vineet's father filed an FIR On February 16, Shankar and around 20 boys from his gang arrived at the hotel. Everyone had sticks, rods, and hockey sticks in their hands. They didn't give anyone a chance to recover. They caused a lot of vandalism. After this, Alok Rai filed an FIR against Shankar Pandey and the boys from his gang. 7 months later, on September 17, 2024, the police arrested Shankar and sent him to jail. On August 6, 2025, Shankar got bail and came out of jail. About this incident of assault at the hotel, Alok says, 'These people had come to the hotel to drink alcohol. We are business people; we don't want disputes. But vandalism was done, so we called the Kotwal Sahab and got these people arrested. Then what action was taken against them? We didn't pay attention to that. It is reported that after coming out of jail, Shankar had started extorting money'. 'Committed murder, he should meet the same fate' Vineet’s mother and wife, Aditi, were inconsolable when visitors arrived at the family home. As soon as they were asked about the incident, they broke down in tears. Repeatedly, they said, “He (Shankar) has left a 3-month-old child without a father. Who will support him now?” Vineet’s aunt, Gudiya Rai, described him as a simple and soft-spoken person. She said, “Vineet had no such enmity that someone would want to kill him. The criminals riddled his body with bullets from the neck down to the waist. I only want those criminals to meet the same fate that they gave to our boy.” Another aunt, Vimala Rai, questioned how a dispute at a hotel two years ago could escalate to murder. She said, “We had no idea that the matter was this serious. We were all here when the dispute happened. After receiving a call from the hotel, Alok bhaiya went there. His only mistake was that he got Shankar arrested.” Guard says - On the night of incident, 2 boys came first, returned after checking the situation After talking to police officers related to the murder case, it became clear that the attackers knew that Vineet and his family members had dinner at the hotel on May 29. Vineet's younger brother Aadesh Rai, relative Rishabh Rai, and 2 friends were there. Before 11 PM at night, 2 boys came. They asked guard Shambhu Yadav for 16 beers, then said okay give us 8. When it came to payment, they said they would pay via UPI. Shambhu told manager Navneet Singh to get the payment done through UPI. The boys started making excuses again that the scanner wasn't working. The mobile needs to be charged. Actually, their intention was to come inside the hotel and see who was present. They found out that there were more than 4 people inside. After this, everyone left from there. In a while, they returned to the hotel and stood outside the gate with weapons. They started waiting for Vineet and the rest of the people to come out. That night, before going out, Vineet also asked Aadesh to go home. To this, he said, " You go ahead, we will come tomorrow morning. After this, Vineet came downstairs''. Guard said- They were firing bullets, my legs were trembling Guard Shambhu says- When Vineet came down the stairs, we opened the gate. We were a little behind him. As soon as Vineet sat on the Bullet, a boy came from the side and opened fire. He continuously fired bullets at Vineet. Then he pointed the pistol towards me. I ran and went to the roof. I told Aadesh and Rishabh bhaiya that Vineet has been shot. My legs were trembling at that time. We couldn't see who those people were. Other people present around the hotel say that day, not just 4, but more than 10 boys had come to carry out the incident. From the way the firing happened, it was clear that not just Vineet, but everyone was the target. Those people didn't come down; that's why their lives were saved. After Kamlesh's encounter, wife raised questions In the Vineet murder case, an FIR was filed against Shankar Pandey, Kamlesh Chaudhary Bind, Alok Dwivedi, and Jagdish Yadav. On June 3, police conducted an encounter of Kamlesh Bind. Kamlesh had gotten married in April 2026. His wife said, " The police took all of us from home. They beat him in front of us at the police station and then took him to the forest and killed him''. This was the statement after which political statements started coming out. Some people started speaking in favor, and some raised questions about the encounter. SP's Ghosi seat MP Rajiv Rai and Ghazipur MP Afzal Ansari met with Kamlesh Bind's family. Not just SP, but Sanjay Nishad, president of BJP's ally Nishad Party, also raised questions about the encounter. He said that the main accused in the Vineet Rai murder case is still at large. Show the same kind of action against them, too. This is a discriminatory attitude towards the Nishad-Bind community. Some officers are creating an atmosphere against the government. Such incidents can prove harmful in an election year. Deputy CM Keshav Maurya said that the police have to take strict measures many times to control crime. If the family or any other party complains in any case, then an investigation is also conducted. The Ghazipur encounter case will also be investigated.

stories.title: Stolen puppets Jojo-Johnny found:Artist says, 'Broke down after reunion'; duo rose to fame for making Premanand Maharaj laugh
stories.summary: Puppets Jojo and Johnny have become a part of my life. Recently, while visiting Vrindavan, Jojo and Johnny, kept in my bag, were left behind in an e-rickshaw. I wandered around for 48 hours searching for them. I kept going to police stations. As soon as I found Jojo and Johnny, I cried a lot. It felt like meeting someone close to me. This is what Rahul Mishra, a ventriloquist (the art of speaking without moving lips) and puppet artist from Jaipur, says. Rahul, who came into the limelight by making Premanand Maharaj laugh with his performance, is entertaining people across the country through bhajan and cultural programs. After the parikrama in Vrindavan, on June 4, puppets Jojo and Johnny kept in his bag were stolen. How did he get them back? Artist Rahul Mishra shared with Dainik Bhaskar in an exclusive conversation the story from starting shows with puppets Jojo and Johnny to meeting Premanand Maharaj. Created Johnny as a hobby after losing job during COVID Jojo and Johnny are puppets. Behind these two puppet characters is ventriloquist and puppet artist Rahul Mishra. Rahul has won a place in the hearts of millions of people through his art. Rahul used to work in a finance company on a salary of 9 thousand rupees. Later, during COVID, Rahul, who lost his job and was battling depression, created Johnny as a hobby. This hobby became his identity. Jojo was gifted to him by someone. Question: The news of Jojo and Johnny getting lost in Vrindavan was much discussed. What exactly happened? Rahul Mishra: We were returning to the hotel from the Parikrama Marg. Our luggage was kept in the e-rickshaw and Jojo-Johnny were also in it. The crowd was so heavy that after getting down, we forgot them in the e-rickshaw. By the time we called out, the e-rickshaw driver deliberately ignored us and left. After that, we kept going around the police post, station and tourism department the whole night. We didn't get any concrete help from anywhere. We didn't sleep all night. In the morning, we started searching again. Later, our acquaintances arranged a meeting with the SHO sahab. He took the matter seriously and deployed a team of 12 people for the search. The hotel manager gave us his bike. The four of us split into groups of two and set out to search. Finally, we found that e-rickshaw driver in front of Banke Bihari temple. Based on his identification, we reached his house. He had kept Jojo-Johnny safe. He had hidden them in a corner, covered with tarpaulin. When asked why he didn't return them, he said he got greedy. For me, Jojo-Johnny are not like some luggage, they are like my life. Question: How did those 48 hours pass? Rahul Mishra: They were very difficult. I even broke down crying in front of the SHO sir. I was just saying that somehow my Jojo-Johnny should be found. The SHO had said to have faith in Bihari ji. See the miracle, Jojo-Johnny were found right in front of the Banke Bihari temple. When I found them, I cried a lot. It felt as if I had met someone close after years. I just sat and kept looking at them. Question: How was your first meeting with Premanand Maharaj? Rahul Mishra: I have met Premanand Maharaj many times, but the first meeting was very wonderful. I was just having normal conversations and he was laughing so heartily, like a child laughs. He saw the complete childhood within both of them. I can never forget that moment. It is said that before dying, all the sins you have committed come before your eyes. Perhaps on the day of my last moment, I will only remember that time when I made Maharaj ji laugh. I mean, Maharaj ji laughed because of my art and we also witnessed such a divine play of Maharaj ji. It is said that saints don't perform actions, saints perform divine plays, so Maharaj ji had performed that divine play. When we met Premanand ji for the first time, he used to stay in solitude more. He was not able to reach out to people much. Travel was stopped, when he met Johnny-Jojo, his happiness knew no bounds. Question: Did your comedy style change after meeting Premanand Maharaj? Rahul Mishra: Absolutely, before this I used to do dark comedy. After winning India's Latent Show, I felt that this kind of content gets views. After that, I started making similar videos. I used to use abusive language too and those videos also got views. When I met Premanand Maharaj ji, I understood that if you have good talent, people will like you even without abuses. That very day I decided that I would never use abuses in videos again. Later, I also decided that I wouldn't use abuses in real life either. Question: How did Johnny and Jojo come about? Rahul Mishra: We had created Johnny just for timepass. I had asked my friend Mac to make a puppet. We thought we would have fun on TikTok. Initially we used to dub, later started giving voice. Johnny's name was given by my friend's niece. Her name is also Shri and later it was by Shriji's grace that Johnny became famous. Then later Johnny was given the name Jagannath Sharan and Jojo got the name Janaki Sharan. Jojo was gifted to me. A person was going through depression, he said I'm giving you Johnny's brother. That's how Jojo came into my life. Question: What kind of programs do you do with Jojo-Johnny today? Rahul Mishra: We travel all over India. We do sankirtans, also do corporate events. We have one condition that there should be no alcohol during the program and people should only focus on the presentation. Today Jojo-Johnny has received love from B Prak, Indresh Upadhyay Maharaj, Rajnaji Maharaj, Saurabh Joshi and many big people. Question: Premanand Maharaj often listens to bhajans from Jojo-Johnny. Please sing for us here as well. Rahul Mishra: This is a great blessing for us. When Maharajji asks us to sing some bhajans, it feels like the true purpose of our art is being fulfilled. Jojo and Johnny are not just entertaining now, but also spreading the message of bhajans and devotion. Johnny sang the bhajan 'Ladli apne charno mein rakh lo...' and Johnny sang the bhajan 'Tu na sambhale to hamein kaun sambhale...' Question: What do you consider the biggest achievement of your life? Rahul Mishra: I have received a lot till today, received love from many people, but my biggest achievement is when Premanand Maharaj laughed because of me. I met him for the first time on February 19th. I can never forget that. There is no greater award for me than that. If someone asks what is the most memorable moment of my life, I would mention that day without thinking.

stories.title: Storm and rain hit Lucknow-Unnao, trees uprooted, 1 killed:2 more days of intense heat; pre-monsoon showers to bring weather relief thereafter
stories.summary: Severe heat continues to grip Uttar Pradesh. Late on Monday night, rain accompanied by strong winds occurred in Lucknow, Unnao, and nearby areas. Several trees were uprooted in parts of Unnao, and an elderly man died after being trapped under a fallen tree. Power supply was also disrupted in several villages. However, bright sunshine returned across most districts, including the state capital, from Tuesday morning. Conditions remain particularly severe in Bundelkhand and the districts of southern Uttar Pradesh, where intense sunlight and heatwave-like conditions have made life difficult for residents. Meanwhile, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a heatwave alert for 16 districts of the state for Tuesday. Strong hot winds during the day and temperatures ranging between 42°C and 44°C, or even higher, have been forecast for several districts in Bundelkhand and Purvanchal. At the same time, a new western disturbance is expected to become active from June 11, creating favourable conditions for pre-monsoon activity. Between June 11 and June 13, various parts of the state are likely to receive light rain or drizzle accompanied by strong winds. According to the IMD, the monsoon, which is currently running three days behind schedule nationally, has now gained momentum. It is expected to reach Uttar Pradesh around its normal arrival date of June 20 and cover the entire state within the following 10 days. Lucknow's senior scientist, Atul Kumar Singh, informed- The ongoing fluctuations in weather in UP will continue for the next few days. On 9th and 10th June, there is a possibility of temperature increase in most districts. This will intensify the effect of heat. From June 11, pre-monsoon rains will occur due to the activation of western disturbance. Then, the weather will start becoming somewhat cooler. The mercury will roll down below 40C. stories.title: UP Assembly elections likely to be held 3 months early:Census and board exams cited as key reasons; who stands to gain — BJP or SP?
stories.summary: 8 June, New Delhi – INDIA bloc meeting was held in Delhi, in which 25 political parties participated. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav from Uttar Pradesh also attended. Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge said that he will write a letter to the Chief Justice of India regarding SIR and the impartiality of elections. 5 June, New Delhi – A meeting of prominent Dalit and extremely backward class leaders from Uttar Pradesh was held with Rahul Gandhi. Ahead of the assembly elections, this was seen as an attempt to further strengthen SP’s ‘PDA’ formula. 4 June, Lucknow – BJP Organisation General Secretary Dharampal Singh said that the party will adopt the West Bengal election model in the Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. He added that 1.76 lakh booth guardians will be appointed quickly. Leaders of the BJP’s 98 organisational districts were present in the meeting. These three developments indicate the possibility that Uttar Pradesh assembly elections may be held before the scheduled time. Election Commission officials say that the Special Summary Revision programme of the voter list is to be released. Sources in Lucknow's bureaucracy are citing the national census as a major reason behind this. The elections are proposed to be held in February, and the second phase of the census is also scheduled to begin in the same month. Normally, the final voter list is published in mid-January. If the Commission decides to hold early elections, this time the final voter list may be published by November. SP and BSP leaders believe that the BJP has already sensed the impact of a possible recession, and that is why it wants early elections. 3 major reasons for conducting elections before schedule 1- Same staff, Two major duties The first phase of the census is ongoing in the country, which will continue till September 30. Its second phase is scheduled between February 9 and 28, 2027. Social-economic and caste information of people will be collected in this. In UP, 5.25 lakh teachers and more than 600 SDMs/DMs have been assigned duty for this. The number of booths in UP has increased to 1.77 lakh. For this, more than 7 lakh employees are needed for election duty. Officials associated with the election say that the staff conducting the census is the same one conducting the elections. If both tasks happen simultaneously, the entire system from the secretariat to the gram panchayats will come to a standstill. 2- Clash with Board Examinations In the months of February-March, UP, CBSE and ICSE board examinations also take place. Lakhs of teachers remain busy conducting exams and checking answer sheets. In 2022, board examinations were conducted after the assembly elections. 3- Changing atmosphere due to economic slowdown and Inflation PM Narendra Modi and Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi have also expressed concerns about the economic crisis and inflation in the coming days. The impact of recession and inflation may be directly visible on the public in the last quarter of the financial year (January-March). In such a situation, people's anger may be directed towards the ruling party. BJP would not want to take such a risk. Preparations of political parties in UP As soon as election signals were received, all political parties in UP entered 'election mode'. Talking about 2022, BSP had already decided its coordinators and in-charges. The first list was released on January 15. SP released its first list on January 13, 2022, after the code of conduct came into effect. BJP's first list was made public on January 15, 2022. To understand what kind of preparations are being made this time, Dainik Bhaskar spoke with officials from BJP, SP and BSP... BJP has sent minister-in-charge to districts SP has finalised 200 candidates; names will be announced ahead of time Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party and BSP have finalised candidates Om Prakash Rajbhar's Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party has deployed in-charges on 44 seats. These will be the candidates in the election. BSP chief Mayawati has also finalised the names of her in-charges on about 50 seats behind the scenes. She has made 5 names public. Mayawati has held meetings with district in-charges and asked them to create an electoral atmosphere in the region. Who benefits from early elections? BJP doesn't want to give time for preparation Senior journalist Yogesh Mishra says that the government doesn't want to give the opposition a chance to prepare. Scheduling the second phase of the census during election time is a clear indication that the government wants elections before time. BJP believes that conducting sudden elections will not give opposition parties a full opportunity to prepare. Besides, conducting elections before the impact of the recession becomes visible on the ground will be safer for the government. Attempt to avoid the impact of inflation Senior journalist Virendranath Bhatt says that conducting the census and elections together is extremely difficult for the administrative machinery. As far as inflation is concerned, it is not the government's failure, but due to the Iran-American war. However, it does have an impact on elections. That's why the government may conduct elections earlier to avoid its effects. It remains to be seen how much SP can capitalise on this. Picture of election will emerge from the publication of voter list An official from the Chief Electoral Officer's office says that if elections are held before January, the voter list of SIR 2025-26 can be used as the basis. Even if elections are held earlier, the commission has sufficient time for preparations.

stories.title: Dispute emerges over Khan Sir's ancestral properties in Deoria:Relatives' allegations include mafia links, involvement in Patna firing case
stories.summary: A man identified as Imran Khan from Deoria, Uttar Pradesh, who claims to be the uncle of Faizal Khan (popularly known as Khan Sir), has made serious allegations against him. He reportedly said, “Khan Sir has become a big mafia figure in Bihar. It even seems that he himself got the firing done to frame the owner of a neighbouring coaching centre in Patna. Whatever is happening with Khan Sir is justified. When sins pile up, they eventually lead to downfall. His truth is now coming out.” He further claimed that Khan Sir owns a luxurious house in the Bhathpar Rani area of Deoria, where his extended family and relatives live. This comes after an incident on the night of June 2, when firing took place at Khan Sir’s coaching institute in Patna. A video of his bodyguards opening fire during the incident had surfaced. Police have already arrested both bodyguards and sent them to jail, and Khan Sir has also been questioned in connection with the case. Since then, Khan Sir has been under public and media scrutiny. A Bhaskar team also visited his ancestral village in Deoria as part of its ground report. 3 houses built in Bhathpar Rani Nagar Panchayat Bhathpar Rani Nagar Panchayat in Deoria district, located about 45 km from the district headquarters, has three houses linked to Khan Sir’s family. In Ward No. 11 (Gudri Bazaar area, near Madan Mohan Malaviya Degree College), there is a single-storey ancestral house spread across around 1,000 square feet, where Khan Sir reportedly spent his childhood. It is said that after a family dispute over the ancestral property, the family built a second house in 2021 during the COVID period in Ward No. 7, Rani Pokhra, and shifted there. Later, Khan Sir is said to have constructed a luxurious bungalow in Ward No. 1, Lakhnha alias Domdih, where the family now resides. Locals, however, trace the family’s roots back further. A neighbour, Chhotu Khan, said that Khan Sir’s grandfather, Iqbal Khan, originally belonged to Dasrathpur village in Gonda district of Uttar Pradesh. He later moved to Bhathpar Rani in Deoria, where the family settled permanently. Iqbal Khan had three sons: Basheer Khan, Naeem Khan, and Saeed Khan. The family of Basheer Khan lives in Bhathpar Rani, while there is no clear information about Naeem and Shahid. Chhotu further said that Basheer Khan’s three sons are Faizal Khan (popularly known as Khan Sir), the eldest; his brother Faisal Khan, who lives in Bihar; and the youngest, Saif Khan, who is currently studying in Class 10 at Shivam Science College in Bhathpar Rani. According to Chhotu Khan, Khan Sir studied up to Class 8 at Param Mission School in Bhathpar Rani, where his grandfather also worked as a teacher. He completed his high school from Ram Manohar Lohia Inter College in Pakri Babu village, followed by intermediate and then a BSc from a branch of Siddiqui Ahmed Inter College in Deoria. After completing his graduation, he moved to Prayagraj to prepare for competitive exams and later shifted to Bihar, where he began running a coaching institute. During the COVID-19 period, as online education gained momentum, Khan Sir started uploading educational videos on YouTube and other social media platforms, which brought him nationwide popularity. After moving to Bihar, he continued visiting Deoria frequently. Between 2021 and 2025, he is said to have built a luxurious bungalow and a smaller house in Ward No. 1, Lakhnha alias Domdih, Bhathpar Rani, located about 500 metres apart. The bungalow was inaugurated in May 2025. After his marriage to A.S. Khan, he reportedly stayed there for two days with his family before returning to Patna. His parents and younger brother currently reside in the house. He claimed that when the construction of Khan Sir’s bungalow was underway, a drain was also planned near his house. However, a dispute arose over the work, after which, according to him, Khan Sir used his influence and got the drainage construction halted. It is alleged that officials, including the lekhpal and SDM, stopped the work following a call from Patna, and the project has remained stalled since then. Due to the incomplete drain, road construction in the area has also not progressed. The councillor further said that Khan Sir has never acknowledged Bhathpar Rani publicly. He added that while some people call him a pride of Bhathpar Rani, he has neither mentioned his birthplace nor even referred to Deoria or Uttar Pradesh in his public statements. Khan Sir’s cousin uncle, Imran Ahmad Khan, has alleged that Faizal Khan, alias Khan Sir, is trying to grab their ancestral land. A dispute is reportedly ongoing over Khan Sir’s ancestral house and an adjoining 1,500 square feet plot in Ward No. 11, Gudri Bazaar, Bhathpar Rani. Imran, who claims to be Khan Sir’s paternal uncle, said that Khan Sir’s grandfather, Iqbal Khan and his father had jointly purchased several properties in the past. However, he accused Khan Sir of acting dishonestly and attempting to take control of their ancestral property. Imran further alleged that Khan Sir had filed a civil case in the district court as part of a “conspiracy”, but lost the case there and then moved to the High Court. He claimed that the family is being harassed and pressured in an attempt to fully occupy their property, which he insists is ancestral land belonging to them. He alleged that Khan Sir had once asked to use their field for a function during his brother Faisal Khan’s wedding. When they refused, he claimed that pressure was exerted and they were threatened, though he said they did not get intimidated. Raju Mishra further remarked that a teacher is expected to remain simple and connected with students and society, but according to him, Khan Sir now behaves more like a celebrity and considers himself a very big public figure rather than a teacher.

stories.title: How Kainchi Dham became Neem Karoli Baba's tapobhoomi:Predicted Charan Singh's journey to the PM's post
stories.summary: Every year on June 15, lakhs of devotees from across India and abroad gather at Kainchi Dham to celebrate the temple's consecration anniversary. Today, the Ashram founded by Neem Karoli Baba is one of India's most revered spiritual destinations. But according to memoirs published in the book Divya Anubhuti by Vijay Chhabria and Dr. Deepak Patwardhan, the story of Kainchi Dham began with a simple meeting between the saint and local resident Purnanand Tiwari. The day the blanket-clad saint arrived According to the memoirs of Umesh Tiwari, one afternoon he and his elder sister had returned home after grazing cattle. While playing near an old abandoned structure close to their house, they noticed an Ambassador car stop nearby. Two men stepped out of the vehicle. One of them was wrapped in a blanket. Without any formal introduction, he walked into the outer room of their home and lay down on an old wooden platform while his companion fanned him. At the time, no one realized that this visitor would later become known as Neem Karoli Baba and that his arrival would mark the beginning of Kainchi Dham's history. Children's anger turned into reverence Umesh recalled that he and his sister were initially annoyed that strangers had occupied their play area. However, the moment they looked at the saint's face, their anger disappeared. They were struck by his calm presence and spiritual aura and instinctively bowed at his feet. The saint then gently asked, "Where is your father? Go and call him." The children informed their father, Purnanand Tiwari, who was having lunch. Believing the visitor to be an ordinary sadhu, he asked them to tell the man that he was ill and asleep. When the children delivered the message, Baba reportedly laughed and remarked, "Look at this man. He is sitting there eating and says he is asleep." He then instructed his companion, Upendra, to bring Purnanand to him if necessary. Realizing that the saint somehow knew exactly what he was doing, Purnanand immediately rushed to meet him. "I want to build a temple here" After the meeting, Baba revealed the purpose of his visit. "I want to build a temple in your Kainchi," he told Purnanand Tiwari. "Tell me where it should be built." Purnanand humbly replied that Baba himself possessed the wisdom to choose the location. However, Baba insisted on hearing his opinion. Eventually, Purnanand pointed to a site near the river where revered saints Kamalagiri Baba and Somwari Baba were believed to have performed intense spiritual practices. Standing by the river, Baba chose the site Baba crossed the river with a group of followers and reached the location. Standing atop a large rock and surveying the surrounding hills, he reportedly declared: "This is the place." Purnanand expressed concern that the land belonged to the Forest Department and that permission for construction might not be granted. Baba reportedly replied with confidence, saying that the site was a sacred land of accomplished saints and that the temple would be built there. The search for the ancient sacred fire pit The next day, Baba returned with Forest Conservator Mr. Soni and other officials. After entering a dense forest area covered with thorny bushes, Baba wandered around for some time before tossing a flower into the air. He instructed those present to dig where the flower landed. When asked how deep they should dig, Baba reportedly said that the site contained the remains of an ancient dhuni—a sacred fire pit used by saints during meditation. After digging about one and a half feet, workers reportedly discovered layers of ash and a stone structure resembling an old meditation fire pit. Baba is said to have expressed satisfaction, believing that the spiritual center of the land had been found. Seeking land approval from Forest Minister Charan Singh Baba later discussed the temple project with Forest Department officials. They informed him that approval would be required from the Forest Minister, Chaudhary Charan Singh. According to the memoir, Baba described Charan Singh as blunt in speech but pure-hearted and promised to speak with him personally. Soon afterward, Charan Singh visited Kainchi and inspected the proposed temple site. After reviewing the location, he reportedly instructed officials to provide not only the required land but even more if necessary. He also ordered the preparation of lease documents at a nominal annual lease rate of one rupee and permitted construction work to begin. A prediction that later came true Pleased by the support, Baba is said to have blessed Charan Singh and told him: One day, you will become the Prime Minister of this country. Years later, the prediction appeared to come true when Charan Singh went on to serve as the Prime Minister of India. The first brick was laid by Purnanand Tiwari According to Umesh Tiwari, the bond between Neem Karoli Baba and his father became deeply personal after that first meeting. When the foundation of the Kainchi temple was laid, Baba reportedly asked Purnanand Tiwari to place the first brick. Later, he was also invited to participate in the foundation ceremony of the temple at Panki in Kanpur. A spiritual legacy that continues today Though Neem Karoli Baba is no longer physically present, devotees believe his teachings and spiritual legacy continue to inspire millions. Today, Kainchi Dham remains a major center of faith, meditation and devotion, attracting visitors from around the world. Kainchi Dham was established in the 1960s Located near Bhowali in Uttarakhand's Nainital district, Kainchi Dham was established by Neem Karoli Baba in the 1960s along the banks of the Shipra River. The Ashram and Hanuman temple have since become internationally known for their spiritual atmosphere, natural beauty and association with the revered saint.

stories.title: Judge asks convict what he would do if released:‘I’ll kill again,’ he replies; Ghazipur court awards death penalty, orders hanging till death
stories.summary: A court in Uttar Pradesh's Ghazipur has sentenced Amjad Khan to death by hanging for the brutal murder of his four-year-old nephew, Daniyal alias Adnan Khan, whose throat was slit during a family dispute in 2021. According to victim-side counsel Akhilesh Singh, Additional District and Sessions Judge Shakti Singh questioned the convict before delivering the sentence. The judge reportedly asked Amjad what he would do if released. The convict replied that he would kill anyone who interfered with him. When asked whether he felt any remorse for murdering the child, Amjad allegedly answered that he had none. Shocked by the response, the judge awarded the death penalty, observing that the case fell into the category of the rarest of rare crimes. After pronouncing the sentence, the judge broke the nib of his pen, a symbolic gesture sometimes associated with death penalty judgments. See 2 pictures... Judge: Mother's pain cannot be expressed in words While delivering the verdict, Judge Shakti Singh remarked that the victim was only four years old and had no understanding of the world's complexities. He noted that all limits of cruelty had been crossed in the murder and that the child's mother had witnessed her own brother killing her son. The judge said the trauma and pain suffered by the mother could not be expressed in words. Child killed over minor dispute The incident occurred on October 21, 2021, in Bara village under Gahmar Kotwali police station limits in Ghazipur district. Daniyal had come to his maternal grandparents' home with his mother, Shabana Naz. During the visit, Amjad Khan allegedly got into a minor argument with his elder sister. In a fit of rage, he attacked his nephew with a knife and slit the child's throat in front of his mother. According to the prosecution, the child's head remained attached to the neck by only a few inches after the attack. Family members testified against accused An FIR under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code was lodged by the victim's uncle, Arbaaz Khan. During the trial, nine witnesses testified before the court, including three sisters and a brother of the accused. The court relied on witness testimonies and other evidence before convicting Amjad Khan and awarding the death sentence. No remorse visible after verdict Police took the convict into custody immediately after the judgment and sent him to jail. Witnesses said Amjad showed no emotion while hearing the sentence and appeared unrepentant even as he was escorted to a prison van. Grieving father says son's memory still haunts him Speaking after the verdict, Daniyal's father, also named Amjad Khan, became emotional while remembering his son. He said Daniyal was his only son between two daughters and that the loss continues to haunt him every day. Although another son was born after the tragedy and is now two years old, he said the void left by Daniyal's death can never be filled.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:SP MP criticises posts on Akhilesh Yadav’s daughter; Indian-crewed vessel comes under fresh attack off Oman coast more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Indian-crewed vessel comes under fresh attack off Oman coast Another vessel carrying an Indian crew came under attack near Oman’s Shinas port on Thursday. Following the incident, the Indian Embassy in Oman said it was in contact with local authorities and was closely monitoring the situation. The development comes a day after three Indian seafarers died following a US military strike on the tanker Settebello in the Gulf of Oman. 2. SP MP criticises posts on Akhilesh Yadav’s daughter, calls it cheap political targeting Samajwadi Party members are angry over objectionable posts on social media targeting Akhilesh Yadav's 23-year-old elder daughter, Aditi Yadav. Samajwadi Party MP from Ghosi seat in Mau, Rajiv Rai, on Wednesday, criticised the BJP and UP Police. 3. UP promotes 36 PCS officers to IAS, Anju Kataria among those elevated 36 PCS officers from UP will be promoted. They will also be assigned new responsibilities. The officers to be promoted include Resident Commissioner, Special Secretary, Additional Commissioner, ADM, Secretary, and officers from several development authorities. 4. Keralam reports first Nipah virus case of 2026 A 43-year-old man from Kozhikode, Keralam, has tested positive for the Nipah virus, prompting authorities to issue a high alert across the state. 5. Shankaracharya alleges thefts at Ram Temple, claims CCTV footage deleted, probe demanded Politics continues over the claim of theft of 7 crore rupees from the offerings received at the Ayodhya Ram Temple. Meanwhile, Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand said in Etah on Thursday, 'Theft has been happening at the Ram Temple since the time of Shila Pujan (stone worship). How many allegations have been made. 6. Overnight demolition in Etawah shrine site followed by sapling plantation across cleared area Syed Baba's shrine in Etawah, UP, was demolished by a bulldozer on Wednesday night. When villagers arrived on Thursday morning, there was no trace of the shrine left. The entire land had been levelled. 7. SC judge recuses from hearing Jacqueline Fernandez's money laundering case Supreme Court judge Justice Prashant Kumar Mishra on Thursday recused himself from hearing actor Jacqueline Fernandez's plea challenging a Delhi court order that framed charges against her in the ₹200 crore money laundering case linked to alleged conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar. 8. Boyfriend forces abortion pills on nursing student in Varanasi, leading to her death A 19-year-old nursing student died in Varanasi after consuming abortion pills. She was 3 months pregnant. Her boyfriend had pressured her into taking the medicine. On Wednesday morning at 11:30 AM, the student's blood-soaked body was found on the hostel stairs. 9. Bulldozer wedding in Moradabad goes viral as groom smokes cigarette, police act In Moradabad, the groom set off for the wedding procession on a bulldozer. The bulldozer sometimes lifted the wedding guests 10 feet up and sometimes brought them down to the road. During this, the groom kept smoking cigarettes and blowing rings. He kept dancing. He kept gesturing to the children sitting with him to dance. 10. Gold prices fall by ₹1,562 to ₹1.45 lakh/10 gm Gold prices have fallen on June 11. According to the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA), the price of 10 grams of 24-carat gold has decreased by ₹1,562 to ₹1.45 lakh.

stories.title: US attack near Strait of Hormuz claims UP sailor's life:Wife collapses, grieving family recalls last phone call
stories.summary: Shivanand Chaurasia (38), a resident of Deoria district in Uttar Pradesh, was killed in an American attack near the Strait of Hormuz while working aboard the Singapore-flagged vessel MT Settebello. Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal has confirmed the death. Shivanand was employed as an engine fitter on the ship and had been working overseas for the past nine months. Reports said the vessel was passing through waters near the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday when the attack took place, resulting in his death. The Indian Embassy in Oman informed Shivanand's younger brother, Ram Pravesh Chaurasia, who lives in Dubai, about the incident on Thursday morning. He later conveyed the news to the family in Deoria. As soon as the family received the information, grief spread through the household. Shivanand's mother and wife were left devastated by the news. Shivanand's father, Ramji Chaurasia, said his son used to call home every day. The family last spoke to him on June 8, when he talked to his father and wife for nearly 20 minutes. According to the family, Shivanand had told them that his ship was anchored near the coast of Oman and that he would soon return to India. Ramji Chaurasia said contact with his son was lost after that conversation when his mobile phone suddenly became unreachable. "The whole family was waiting for Shivanand to return home," he said. Fighting back tears, the grieving father added, “A mountain of sorrow has fallen upon our family.” See 2 photos Wife faints after hearing of husband's death Shivanand Chaurasia was a resident of Surauli village in Deoria district's Surauli police station area. He was the elder of two brothers. His family includes his father Ramji Chaurasia, mother Kalavati Devi, wife Sushila, five-year-old son Rajveer and two-year-old daughter Vanika. The news of his death left the family devastated. His wife Sushila has been inconsolable and is repeatedly losing consciousness. His parents are struggling to cope with the loss and have been in tears since receiving the news. Family members said Shivanand had been working in difficult conditions abroad to secure a better future for his family. He was the sole breadwinner, supporting household expenses and his children's education. Family informed by Indian Embassy According to the family, the Indian Embassy informed them that a bombing near the Strait of Hormuz had claimed Shivanand's life. He was reportedly aboard a vessel travelling from Oman towards India when the attack occurred. Villagers seek government support for family Residents of the village have urged the government to provide financial assistance to the bereaved family and offer a job to one of its members. They said Shivanand's death has left the family facing severe hardship. Family members have also appealed for his body to be brought back to the village at the earliest so that his last rites can be performed with full honours. Village mourns as family awaits mortal remains News of Shivanand's death plunged Surauli village into grief. By Thursday afternoon, relatives, neighbours and villagers had gathered at his home to offer condolences to the family. Officials from the tehsil administration and local authorities also visited the family and expressed their sympathies. Authorities said formal procedures related to the incident abroad are underway. Efforts are being made through the Indian Embassy and other agencies to bring Shivanand's body back to India. Administration assures all possible assistance Deoria District Magistrate Madhusudan Hulgi said the district administration is coordinating with the state and central governments to assist the family. "We are in touch with the state government and the Government of India. All possible assistance will be provided to the family. The district administration stands with them," he said. Tanker damaged in attack near Hormuz The oil tanker MT Settebello, on which Shivanand was deployed, came under attack near the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday. Three Indian crew members were confirmed dead in the incident. The vessel also suffered damage during the attack. Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said that the bodies of two victims had been recovered so far. Two vessels with Indian crew attacked in three days Two oil tankers carrying Indian crew members have come under attack within the past three days. The first incident took place on June 8 when tanker MT Marivex was attacked. The vessel had 28 crew members on board, including 24 Indians. All crew members were safely rescued by the Indian Coast Guard and Omani authorities. A second attack took place on June 10 on MT Settebello, which was carrying 24 crew members. Three Indian deaths have been confirmed in that incident. India has strongly condemned the attack and lodged a formal protest with US authorities. Video of US attack on MT Settebello..

stories.title: 3 dead, 8 injured as family's Scorpio crashes into divider:Returning from Kashmir trip, driver dozes off on Ganga Expressway
stories.summary: Three members of a Lucknow family were killed and eight others injured after their Scorpio SUV crashed into a divider on the Ganga Expressway while they were returning from a holiday in Jammu and Kashmir. The accident occurred around 10:30 am on June 10 near the Amroha-Sambhal border in Uttar Pradesh. The victims have been identified as leather businessman Abubakar (40), his younger brother's wife Hina (28), and his niece Junaira (15). The family, residents of the Nakhas area in Lucknow's Chowk locality, had travelled to Kashmir during the children's summer vacation and were on their way home when the accident took place. Scorpio badly damaged after hitting divider According to police and eyewitnesses, the SUV went out of control and slammed into the divider after the driver allegedly fell asleep at the wheel. The front portion of the vehicle was completely damaged in the collision. Tauqeer, who was travelling in a car behind the Scorpio, said the vehicle suddenly swerved before crashing into the divider. "The impact was extremely severe. Two children were thrown out through the vehicle's door. The Scorpio was carrying 11 people," he said. The vehicle suddenly swerved and crashed into the divider Eyewitness Tauqeer, who was coming in a car behind the Scorpio, said that the Scorpio suddenly swerved and crashed into the divider. The impact was so severe that the vehicle was badly damaged. Two children fell out through the vehicle's gate. There were 11 people in the vehicle. Mohammad Umar (Abubakar's brother), who was among the injured, said that the entire family had gone to Jammu and Kashmir for a vacation during the children's summer holidays on June 1. They had left for the return journey on Tuesday night, but the accident occurred on Wednesday morning on the way. Family was returning after summer vacation Mohammad Umar, Abubakar's brother and one of the injured passengers, said the family had left for Jammu and Kashmir on June 1 for a holiday during the summer break. They began their return journey on Tuesday night, but the accident occurred on Wednesday morning while passing through the expressway stretch near the Amroha-Sambhal border. Several family members injured Those injured in the crash include Abubakar's wife Kulsum (38), his brother Mohammad Umar (32), nieces Sidra (14), Haniya (2), Afifa (7) and Hamna (10), Hina's son Mohammad (4), and another relative, Affan. All injured passengers were initially admitted to Sambhal District Hospital. Some of the critically injured were referred to a higher medical centre in Moradabad for treatment. Abubakar succumbed to his injuries during treatment in Sambhal, while Hina and Junaira died during treatment in Moradabad. Police launch investigation Although the accident took place in Amroha district, the crash site was closer to the Sambhal border. Personnel from Kailadevi police station rushed to the spot and shifted the injured to hospital. Sambhal Superintendent of Police Krishna Kumar Bishnoi said preliminary findings suggest the driver may have fallen asleep. Police are investigating all possible causes of the accident. Grief grips Lucknow family News of the tragedy triggered scenes of grief at the family's home in Lucknow. Relatives and neighbours gathered at the residence as soon as they learned about the accident. The bodies of Abubakar, Hina and Junaira were later brought to the family's residence in the Dubagga area. Family members said all three will be buried together at Suppa cemetery. Meanwhile, injured relatives Umar and Affan have also been brought back to Lucknow, while some other family members continue to receive treatment in hospitals.

stories.title: ₹7 crore donation theft alleged at Ayodhya Ram Temple:Former accounts in-charge says he complained to Champat Rai; claims CCTV footage was deleted
stories.summary: The political row over the alleged theft of ₹7 crore from donations received at the Ayodhya Ram Temple continues. Mahipal Singh, who claims to be the temple's former accounts in-charge, told Dainik Bhaskar that theft at the temple was not a new phenomenon and occurred regularly. He alleged that he had personally caught instances of theft. Singh said he had reported the matter to Champat Rai, general secretary of the Ram Temple Trust, and trust member Gopal Ji. However, he claimed that Champat Rai removed him from his post the very next day. He further alleged that CCTV footage from the temple premises dating back eight months was deleted. According to Singh, Champat Rai exercises unchecked authority over the management of the temple complex and those who oppose him are removed from their positions. Meanwhile, on Thursday, Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand said in Etah that theft had been taking place since the time of the temple's foundation stone worship ceremony. There have already been several allegations. When the temple construction began, plots of land started being sold. Land prices would soar to crores of rupees within minutes. Champat Rai has been there from the beginning. The meaning of 'Champat' itself is to take something and run away he said. Mahipal Singh said- Only Champat Rai knows where the offerings are deposited. Mahant said - Those who question the trust are not innocent BJP leader had written a letter saying- CBI, ED should investigate Ayodhya's BJP leader Dr. Rajneesh Singh had written a letter saying- The Ram Temple is the center of faith for crores of devotees. In such a situation, transparency is essential on any dispute or allegation related to offerings, donations, and temple administration. If the allegations are baseless, the truth should be brought out through investigation. Find out what leaders said on the claim of theft... Who is Champat Rai Know the system for counting offerings at Ram Mandir… Bank employees count the offerings at Ram Mandir in the presence of trust members. This work is done under CCTV surveillance. The donated amount is entered into a register. Then it is kept in a locker built within the Ram Mandir premises. The next day, the money is deposited in the bank. The trust's main account is with the State Bank of India in Ayodhya Dham. The entire audit work of the offering amount is done under the supervision of TCS (Tata Consultancy Services). Information on how much offering is received at Ram Mandir is provided only in the trust's meeting. The last time information about offerings was given was in December 2025. 2,475 Crore Rupees Spent on Temple On December 13, 2025, information emerged in the temple trust meeting that the trust had received a total of 4,575 crore rupees till now. In the last 5 years and 9 months, 2,475 crore rupees have been spent on temple construction, expansion of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi complex, purchase of land and buildings, and several other works. At that time, the trust had approximately 2100 crore rupees remaining. More than one crore rupees donated daily to Ayodhya's Ram Temple The consecration ceremony of Lord Ramlala in the Ram Temple took place on January 22, 2024. In the past two years, the image of the Ram Temple has changed rapidly. The main source of the temple's income is donations and interest received on bank deposits. According to a report by the Global Wealth Index-2026, the temple's immovable assets include the main complex of approximately 70 acres and the acquired land around it. Additionally, the grand structure of the temple under construction (whose construction cost alone exceeds ?1,800 crore) takes its total assets beyond ?6,000 crore to ?8,000 crore. Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust was formed on February 5, 2020

stories.title: Fire breaks out at beauty parlour in Hazratganj:Blaze brought under control in an hour; 2 people rescued from smoke
stories.summary: A beauty parlor in Christian Colony, located in the Gautampalli police station area of Hazratganj, caught fire on Thursday morning. The fire brigade arrived upon receiving the information. Two people on the roof above the parlor were surrounded by smoke. Firefighters used a ladder to safely bring them down. During this time, the fire was continuously being extinguished. After about 1 hour of effort, the fire was extinguished, but all the parlor's belongings were completely burnt. See 2 pictures- Information received at 5:42 AM, three fire tenders arrived The Chief Fire Officer stated that at 5:42 AM on Thursday, the Fire Station Hazratganj Control Room received information that a fire had broken out at 'Just For Device' KDA Parlor. Upon receiving the information, three fire tenders from Hazratganj Fire Station and Pushpendra Yadav, the officer-in-charge of Chowk Fire Station, along with his team, rushed to the spot. Upon the arrival of the firefighters, it was discovered that the fire had occurred in the parlor located on the ground floor of the building, while the upper two floors were residential. Due to the smoke emanating from the fire, Hafiz Ullah and Shadab Khan, who were residing in the building, had reached the roof. The firefighters immediately used a ladder to safely bring both of them down. Smoke extracted with the help of smoke exhausters The fire team started pumping with a motor fire engine and launched an operation to extinguish the fire. After this, smoke was extracted from the entire building with the help of smoke exhausters. After much effort, the fire was completely brought under control. Preliminary investigation suggests that the cause of the fire was a short circuit. According to the landlord, the fire started in the parlor operating on the ground floor. The owner of the parlor is Deepika Rathore. There was no loss of life due to the fire, but the goods kept in the parlor were burnt.
